Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Data Analyst (0448)
Description:
Make your career count

At Price Bailey, we provide exciting opportunities for training, personal growth and career engagement. We believe in fostering happiness and fulfilment in your work, whilst supporting and inspiring you to grow. We understand that your life extends beyond the workplace, which is why our Smart Working culture promotes flexibility, allowing you to choose when and where you work, whilst still providing excellent client care.

We are a well-established, independently owned firm of chartered accountants and business advisors, offering a comprehensive range of services including audit, accounting, tax, and corporate finance. We proudly support a diverse client base across the UK and internationally, with a strong focus on entrepreneurial, owner-managed businesses that share our passion for innovation.

What do the team do?

Our IT team plays an important role in helping the firm operate more efficiently, make better-informed decisions and continue to improve the way we deliver services to our clients.

As part of our growing data and digital transformation team, you will help develop, maintain and enhance reporting and analytical solutions that support decision-making across the firm. Working primarily with data from our Practice Management System and associated business applications, you will transform complex data into meaningful insight using SQL, Power BI and other Microsoft technologies.

The firm's reporting environment is built primarily around Microsoft SQL Server and Power BI, with data sourced from Practice Management, Finance, HR, CRM and other operational systems. This role will play a key part in the ongoing development of our reporting, data warehouse and wider business intelligence capabilities.

This is a Cambridge-based role and you'll be expected to attend the office regularly each week to work closely with colleagues and be fully involved in team activities.

What will I be doing?

As a Data Analyst you will have ownership of the following tasks:


Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports and KPI scorecards that provide meaningful insights to stakeholders across the firm.
Analysing business performance data, identifying trends and opportunities across areas such as fee income, utilisation, WIP, debtors and operational performance.
Writing, optimising and maintaining SQL queries, datasets and reporting models to support business intelligence and decision-making.
Supporting the ongoing development of the firm's data warehouse, integrating data from multiple systems and helping to improve data quality.
Creating and maintaining Power BI data models, DAX calculations and Power Query transformations.
Working closely with Partners, Department Heads and operational teams to translate business requirements into effective reporting and analytical solutions.
Promoting a data-driven culture by providing user support, maintaining reporting documentation and contributing to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.


What experience do I need?

Whilst having the following experience is advantageous, we value passion and potential. If you meet the minimum criteria listed below and are eager to develop yourself, we would love to hear from you:


A degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Finance or a similar discipline (minimum criteria).
Prior experienceworking in a Data Analyst or Business Intelligence role within a professional services firm (minimum criteria).
Strong SQL Server experience, including advanced SQL querying, query optimisation and data modelling.
Experience developing reports using Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, dashboard development and row-level security.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query and data analysis techniques.
Experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.


What's on offer?

In addition to your salary, we also offer the following benefits:


25 days annual leave (with the option to buy/sell up to 5 days holiday)
Private medical
Contributory pension scheme
4x life assurance
All employee share scheme
Family friendly policies e.g. paid time off for dependants
2 days paid for volunteering
Cycle to work scheme
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) including shopping discount


Price Bailey aspires to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people, regardless of their social background, age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership. We are an equal opportunities employer and place inclusion at the heart of what we do. Our workplace is one where diversity is embraced and where everyone is empowered to be their authentic selves.

Should you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in the appropriate section of your application. For candidates with a disability who meet the minimum criteria of the role, we also offer a guaranteed interview, which you can opt into as part of your application.

Price Bailey will only accept CV's from recruitment agencies who have been briefed on specific roles by our Resourcing team and where contractual agreement exists already. We do not accept speculative CV's and agency fees will not be owed in these instances. Should you wish to be considered for our approved supplier list please contact recruitment@pricebailey.co.uk

Title: Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You Will Get To Do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience With The Following Would Be a Plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What We Can Offer You


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What To Expect In The Hiring Process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.

Description:
Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:

Reporting on Trust cancer performance internally and externally e.g. the Faster Diagnosis Standard (FDS), 31-day and 62-day standards.
Data quality and assurance which will include monthly data validation.
Ad-hoc reporting and data insights to drive service improvement.


The role will be split between being based at the St Mary’s site in Paddington, with some meetings at other sites, and working from home.


The successful candidate will have strong technical skills (Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI are essential and Qlik and Somerset desirable) as well as extensive NHS cancer knowledge and experience. The post holder will maintain high standards of accuracy and quality whilst managing a varied workload, balancing competing priorities and consistently meeting deadlines. They will be expected to demonstrate excellent organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, taking ownership of tasks and using their initiative to identify opportunities for improvement.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential, as the post holder will be required to build and maintain effective working relationships with a wide range of corporate, operational and clinical managers.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Connect2Hackney, as the internal talent team for the London Borough of Hackney, are excited to offer an opportunity for an experienced Data Analyst to join our forward-thinking Customer Services, Digital & Data team.




In this key role, you will be working at SFIA Level 4 ('Enable') to bridge the gap between raw data and impactful organisational decision-making. You will collaborate with stakeholders across the Council to translate complex business challenges into actionable insights, build user-friendly dashboards, and champion data-driven service improvements that directly benefit Hackney’s residents and local businesses.




Key Responsibilities




Identify, clean, aggregate, and analyse internal and external datasets. Design and automate high-impact visualisations and dashboards that empower leaders to make faster, better-informed decisions.
Partner across directorates and matrixed teams (e.g., Insight Service, Customer Experience, Digital Products) to understand business processes, key KPIs, and analytics requirements.
Collaborate with Data Engineers and data owners to build trusted, reusable datasets using open-source languages and the Council's analytical data platform.
Work within an Agile framework to iteratively deliver insights. Promote data sharing, best practices, and innovative analytical tools across the organisation.
Implement robust data management, privacy, security, and risk controls to maintain the integrity, confidentiality, and accessibility of information assets.
Provide direct line management for an Associate Analyst, contribute to multidisciplinary teams, and join an out-of-hours user support rota (with additional payment provided).




What We Are Looking For




We are seeking an analytical professional operating at SFIA Level 4 who demonstrates autonomy, influence, and strong technical problem-solving capabilities:




Core Competencies & Technical Skills

Data Visualisation: Proven experience using leading data analytics and visualisation tools to design, operationalise, and automate clear reports and visual formats.
Data Science: Ability to investigate complex problem sets, apply data science techniques/programming languages, evaluate models, and integrate data sources.
Data Modelling & Design: Skill in investigating ambiguous enterprise data requirements, planning data structures, and offering architectural guidance.
Business Intelligence: Strong background in querying and optimising non-standard BI tools to streamline operational data and drive governance/management decisions.
Information Assurance: Understanding of risk management, information security, data protection/privacy, and accreditation frameworks.




About You




Comfortable working under general direction, taking accountability, and planning tasks to hit quality targets.
Fluent in translating complex technical data into plain, structured narrative stories for both non-technical and technical audiences.
Adaptable, fast-paced mindset comfortable with iterative design and continuous learning.




Qualifications




Ideally educated to a Bachelor’s degree level and/or holds a relevant professional qualification.
Equivalent practical experience working at a similar technical level will be fully considered in lieu of formal qualifications.




Why Join Hackney Council?




Community Impact: Work directly on corporate objectives and Mayor's priorities that create positive social outcomes for Hackney’s diverse community.
Professional Growth: Active investment in your professional development, training opportunities, and peer networks.
Inclusive Environment: A culture committed to equal opportunities, accessibility, sustainability, and hybrid flexible working

At MIB our people are passionate about making roads safer by getting uninsured and hit-and-run drivers off our roads. Working in partnership with the Police, Insurers and Government our collective aim is to make it a thing of the past but, until that’s accomplished, we’re here to compensate victims quickly, fairly and compassionately.




Last year we helped more than 34,000 people struck by uninsured and hit-and-run drivers and paid over £400 million in compensation to support victims rebuild their lives.




About the role




The Data Insight Analyst will play a key role within the MIB Data Team, delivering high‑quality analysis and insight from complex datasets to support strategic and operational decision‑making.
The role will focus on in‑depth analytical work, translating data into clear, actionable insights, and working closely with business stakeholders and the Data Development team to ensure data solutions meet business needs.
The Data Insight Analyst working with the wider Data team, will act as a bridge between data and the business, combining strong technical capability with an understanding of business context to influence outcomes through evidence‑based insight.




Key responsibilities




Conduct in‑depth exploratory and statistical analysis on large and complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and test hypotheses based on a strong understanding of MIB data.
Combine MIB datasets with selected external data to broaden understanding and contextualise MIB data.
Develop clear, well‑structured analytical outputs that translate technical findings into meaningful business insight.
Apply analytical techniques to answer both ad‑hoc and recurring business questions.
Work closely with business partners & stakeholders to understand requirements, define analytical questions, and shape insight outputs.
Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non‑technical audiences in a clear and compelling way.
Act as a trusted analytical partner, supporting evidence‑based decision‑making across the organisation.
Collaborate with the Data Development team to shape data models, pipelines, and datasets that support analytical and reporting needs.
Validate data quality and ensure analytical outputs are robust, accurate, and fit for purpose.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytical tools, processes, and standards within the team.
Support the development and enhancement of insight‑led reporting and dashboards.
Ensure insights are aligned to organisational priorities and performance measures.
Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support transparency and reuse.




Skills and Experience




Strong experience working with large, complex datasets in a data analytics or insight role.
Advanced experience using Databricks, including working with Spark‑based data environments.
Strong Python skills, with hands‑on experience using Pandas and related analytical libraries.
Experience writing efficient, well‑structured code for data manipulation and analysis.
Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and analytical data models.
Experience working with cloud‑based data platforms (Azure preferred).
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex problems and apply structured thinking.
Ability to interpret data critically, challenge assumptions, and draw meaningful conclusions.
Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to non‑technical audiences.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and business teams.
Confident presenting insights, recommendations, and options to support decision‑making.
Experience supporting reporting and insight functions in a regulated or complex environment.
Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Databricks One or similar).
Experience working in Agile or sprint‑based delivery environments (e.g. Azure DevOps).
Curious and proactive, with a strong desire to understand the “why” behind the data.
Collaborative and team‑focused, with a willingness to share knowledge and best practice.
Organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Committed to continuous learning and development in data and analytics.

Title: Claims Data Analyst
Description:
About Zego



At Zego, we understand that traditional motor insurance holds good drivers back. It's too complicated, too expensive, and it doesn't reflect how well you actually drive. Since 2016, we have been on a mission to change that by offering the lowest priced insurance for good drivers.

From van drivers and gig workers to everyday car drivers, our customers are the driving force behind everything we do. We've sold tens of millions of policies and raised over $200 million in funding and picked up numerous awards, including the Insurance Claims Team Of The Year 2024 as awarded at The Insurance Post's Claims & Fraud Awards. And we're only just getting started.

Purpose of the role



We're looking for a proactive and analytical Claims Data Analyst to help us enhance our Claims and Fraud operations, shaping one of the most vital areas of the insurance industry.

As part of a fast-growing, product-led tech company, you'll play a key role in driving impactful change within our rapidly scaling Claims team. Your insights will power strategic decision-making, improve efficiency, and uncover opportunities for continuous improvement. Expect to work on developing insightful reports and dashboards, collaborating closely with Claims and Fraud teams, and delivering data-backed recommendations to leadership and stakeholders across the business.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-centric environment and are eager to make a real difference in the evolution of claims operations, we'd love to hear from you!

What you will be doing


Design & build core data models and reporting to support Claims and Fraud operations
Develop key reports for senior stakeholders, including Zego leadership, investors, and insurance partners
Analyze performance & identify trends, uncovering key drivers to optimise processes
Spot and size opportunities for continuous improvement, tracking the impact of initiatives
Support strategic decision-making for the Claims and Fraud leadership team
Translate data into compelling stories—delivering actionable insights to senior management
Collaborate cross-functionally, supporting Claims, Fraud, Pricing, and external reporting needs
What you will need to be successful


Got a degree? Great! If not, equivalent experience works too (bonus points if it's in a STEM subject)
SQL Skills - You know your way around data extraction and manipulation like a pro
Power BI Expertise - You've built data models, reports, and dashboards before and can turn raw numbers into something meaningful
Data Storytelling - You can take complex insights and turn them into clear, engaging stories that senior stakeholders (think senior managers, investors, Zego's board, and insurance partners) actually understand
Insurance Know-How (Nice to have!) - If you understand the motor insurance market and what drives commercial performance, that's a big plus
Claims & Financial Acumen (Nice to have!) - Familiarity with claims processes, reserving, and settlements? Even better
Actuarial & Reserving Knowledge (Nice to have!) - If you can be the go-to person between Claims, Fraud, and Actuarial teams, we'd love to have you on board!
What's it like to work at Zego?



Joining Zego is a career-defining move. People go further here, reaching their full potential to achieve extraordinary things. 

We're spread throughout the UK and Europe, and united by our drive to get things done. We're proud of our company and our culture - a friendly and inclusive space where we can lift each other up and celebrate our wins every day.

Together, we're setting the bar higher, delivering exceptional work that makes a difference. Our people are the most important part of our story, and everyone here plays a role. There's loads of room to learn and grow, and you'll get the freedom to steer your career wherever you want.

You'll work alongside a talented group who embrace each other's differences and aren't afraid of a challenge. We recognise our achievements, learn from our mistakes, and help each other to be the best we can be. Together, we're making insurance matter. 

Our approach to AI



We believe in the power of AI to meaningfully improve how we work - helping us move faster, think differently, and focus on what matters most. At Zego, we encourage people to stay curious and intentional about how AI is leveraged in their work and teams to drive practical impact every day. This is your chance to do the most meaningful work of your career - and we'll provide you with the tools, support, and freedom to do it well.

How we work



We believe that teams work better when they have time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid.

Our hybrid way of working is unique. We foster a flexible approach that empowers every Zegon to perform at their best. We ask you to spend at least one day a week in our central London office (next to Liverpool Street). We cover the costs for all company-wide events (3 per year), and also provide a separate hybrid contribution to help pay towards other travel costs. We think it's a good mix of collaborative face time and flexible home-working, setting us up to achieve the right balance between work and life.

Benefits



We reward our people well. Join us and you'll get a market-competitive salary, private medical insurance, company share options, generous holiday allowance, and a whole lot of wellbeing benefits. And that's just for starters.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




Overall Ambition




Nando’s is on a journey to Create Lasting Happiness, making a difference to the lives of our people, our customers, and the communities we work in. Originally started in Johannesburg, South Africa, we pride ourselves on creating memorable experiences for everyone involved in Nando’s: from our employees, communities, founders, and suppliers, but most importantly, our customers.

Whilst we always look back on our history and story with pride, the story is still evolving. We have recently been growing our digital capabilities to ensure the Nando’s experience remains relevant to modern-day customers.




You will be joining a tech team that has grown rapidly in the past five years and is determined to enable change within the restaurant industry by bringing innovative thinking and the latest technology tools and practices to solve some of its most complex problems.







The Data and Analysis Team

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data and Analysis team. Our remit is to ensure everyone has access to the right information, at the right time, and that Nando’s gets the best value out of our data to achieve our business goals.




Our current focus is extracting insights from the data and creating a single source of accurate, timely data as we continue to increase our data maturity and advance our predictive analytic capability and explore the role of AI in the business.




You will be part of our work to support our strategic goals and build a data-informed attitude for addressing our opportunities and challenges.







Our Values

At Nando’s, our values guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for each other every day:

Pride – We take pride in everything we do, from the quality of our food to the impact of our work.
Passion – We bring energy, enthusiasm, and a love for what we do.
Courage – We speak up, challenge the status quo, and are not afraid to try new things.
Integrity – We do the right thing, act honestly, and build trust with each other.
Family – We care for and support one another, creating a sense of belonging where everyone can thrive.







What we're looking for:

As a Data Analyst you will work across a wide range of domains from financial and operational data, to kitchen tech and stock, helping our teams make better decisions grounded in sound analysis. As a curious problem-solver, you will be able to move between the technical and the commercial; and be comfortable building data models as well as presenting findings to senior stakeholders.




In this role you’ll work independently across the full data stack, understanding the ‘why’ behind requests before jumping to the ‘what’, and contributing to the translation of business problems into well-defined, actionable work. You’ll be supported by a collaborative team and won’t be expected to deliver everything solo from day one, but you’ll be expected to grow into doing so.

You will…







Write and maintain SQL models (in Dataform) to transform and serve reliable data across our pipelines
Support data engineers in the design, building and testing of data pipelines, able to contribute meaningfully, not just consume the output
Build and iterate on cloud-based reports and dashboards in Looker (or similar BI tool), giving our support teams and restaurants clear, actionable insight into performance
Translate business questions into well-scoped analysis and understand the problem and domain before reaching for the answer
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, choosing the right medium for the audience
Peer review colleagues’ work and contribute to data quality standards and documentation
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and data tasks, and take the initiative to implement them







Skills required

You will have proven experience in the following:

Writing complex SQL to query, transform and model data across our cloud data platform (window functions, CTEs, complex datatypes)
Building and maintaining data models in Dataform, or a similar data transformation tool such as Snowflake or DBT, with an understanding of how they fit into the broader pipeline
Building reports and dashboards in Looker or a similar BI tool, serving reliable, self-serve data to the business
Using Git as standard practice — branching, pull requests and code review
Contributing to the translation of business requests into clearly scoped, actionable work items
Applying data quality techniques — writing tests, identifying issues proactively and communicating data limitations clearly
Documenting data models, definitions and lineage to a production standard
Understanding data governance principles and championing good data management practice within the team
Applying and understanding when to use relevant statistical methods to support analysis
Supporting data engineers in designing, coding and testing data processing pipelines
Using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude) to improve the speed and quality of your work — critically, not blindly — with an awareness of responsible AI use and data governance implications







You will also display

Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain complex findings in plain language and tell the story behind the data
Genuine intellectual curiosity, actively exploring new tools and methods, including AI, and sharing what you learn with the team
Comfort with ambiguity, able to define the right question and find the “so what” before jumping to answer
A product mindset, understanding the business objective behind every piece of analysis, not just the request on the surface
A proactive approach to improving processes, data quality and ways of working, with the initiative to make it happen, not just flag it
A collaborative team attitude, peer reviewing others’ work, sharing knowledge and contributing to a stronger team




Inclusion

At Nando’s, everyone is welcome. Inspired by our Southern African heritage we know and value the richness that diversity brings to Nando’s. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful culture for all; including our existing and future Nandocas, partners and suppliers, customers and the communities we are a part of. We deliberately work hard to create an environment where every individual is valued, respected and can flourish regardless of who they are, their background or outlook on life.




We welcome applications from a diverse range of individuals and will consider any reasonable adjustments in order to enable candidates to perform as well as possible during the recruitment process.

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data and Analysis team. Our remit is to ensure everyone has access to the right information, at the right time, and that Nando’s gets the best value out of our data to achieve our business goals.


Our current focus is extracting insights from the data and creating a single source of accurate, timely data as we continue to increase our data maturity and advance our predictive analytic capability and explore the role of AI in the business.


You will be part of our work to support our strategic goals and build a data-informed attitude for addressing our opportunities and challenges.



Our Values

At Nando’s, our values guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for each other every day:

  • Pride – We take pride in everything we do, from the quality of our food to the impact of our work.
  • Passion – We bring energy, enthusiasm, and a love for what we do.
  • Courage – We speak up, challenge the status quo, and are not afraid to try new things.
  • Integrity – We do the right thing, act honestly, and build trust with each other.
  • Family – We care for and support one another, creating a sense of belonging where everyone can thrive.



What we're looking for:

As a Data Analyst you will work across a wide range of domains from financial and operational data, to kitchen tech and stock, helping our teams make better decisions grounded in sound analysis. As a curious problem-solver, you will be able to move between the technical and the commercial; and be comfortable building data models as well as presenting findings to senior stakeholders.


In this role you’ll work independently across the full data stack, understanding the ‘why’ behind requests before jumping to the ‘what’, and contributing to the translation of business problems into well-defined, actionable work. You’ll be supported by a collaborative team and won’t be expected to deliver everything solo from day one, but you’ll be expected to grow into doing so.

You will…



  • Write and maintain SQL models (in Dataform) to transform and serve reliable data across our pipelines
  • Support data engineers in the design, building and testing of data pipelines, able to contribute meaningfully, not just consume the output
  • Build and iterate on cloud-based reports and dashboards in Looker (or similar BI tool), giving our support teams and restaurants clear, actionable insight into performance
  • Translate business questions into well-scoped analysis and understand the problem and domain before reaching for the answer
  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, choosing the right medium for the audience
  • Peer review colleagues’ work and contribute to data quality standards and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and data tasks, and take the initiative to implement them



Skills required

You will have proven experience in the following:

  • Writing complex SQL to query, transform and model data across our cloud data platform (window functions, CTEs, complex datatypes)
  • Building and maintaining data models in Dataform, or a similar data transformation tool such as Snowflake or DBT, with an understanding of how they fit into the broader pipeline
  • Building reports and dashboards in Looker or a similar BI tool, serving reliable, self-serve data to the business
  • Using Git as standard practice — branching, pull requests and code review
  • Contributing to the translation of business requests into clearly scoped, actionable work items
  • Applying data quality techniques — writing tests, identifying issues proactively and communicating data limitations clearly
  • Documenting data models, definitions and lineage to a production standard
  • Understanding data governance principles and championing good data management practice within the team
  • Applying and understanding when to use relevant statistical methods to support analysis
  • Supporting data engineers in designing, coding and testing data processing pipelines
  • Using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude) to improve the speed and quality of your work — critically, not blindly — with an awareness of responsible AI use and data governance implications



You will also display

  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain complex findings in plain language and tell the story behind the data
  • Genuine intellectual curiosity, actively exploring new tools and methods, including AI, and sharing what you learn with the team
  • Comfort with ambiguity, able to define the right question and find the “so what” before jumping to answer
  • A product mindset, understanding the business objective behind every piece of analysis, not just the request on the surface
  • A proactive approach to improving processes, data quality and ways of working, with the initiative to make it happen, not just flag it
  • A collaborative team attitude, peer reviewing others’ work, sharing knowledge and contributing to a stronger team


Inclusion

At Nando’s, everyone is welcome. Inspired by our Southern African heritage we know and value the richness that diversity brings to Nando’s. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful culture for all; including our existing and future Nandocas, partners and suppliers, customers and the communities we are a part of. We deliberately work hard to create an environment where every individual is valued, respected and can flourish regardless of who they are, their background or outlook on life.


We welcome applications from a diverse range of individuals and will consider any reasonable adjustments in order to enable candidates to perform as well as possible during the recruitment process.

Title: Insight Analyst
Description:
Company Description/ Business Unit

Location: London (hybrid working 3 office days per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, full time

Additional Benefits: Annual Bonus

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

For over a century, we've been evolving and adapting. Today, as the nation's leading motoring organisation, we offer a wide range of products and services to millions of customers. From roadside assistance to home and motor insurance, and the latest driving technologies, we have it all. As we continue to expand, diversify, and modernise, joining us as an Insight Analyst means you'll play a crucial role in our success and be part of this exciting motoring journey.

Our Chief Operating Office (COO) are the backbone of The AA, providing both stability and structure to support growth and innovation. We are the drivers of change.

This is the job

More than data. Be the insight behind the decision.

As an Insight Analyst at the AA, you will use data, analysis and technology to help our teams make better decisions for our customers and our business. This is a hands-on, mid-level role where you will take ownership of analytical challenges, uncover meaningful insight and turn it into clear recommendations that people can act on.

But this role is about more than what happens behind the screen. You will build trusted relationships with stakeholders, get close to the challenges facing the business, ask the right questions and confidently bring your insight into conversations with people at all levels. You will work across teams to influence thinking, solve problems and make a tangible difference, while continuing to grow your technical and commercial capability.

If you are an analyst who enjoys both the technical challenge of finding the answer and the human challenge of bringing people with you, this is an opportunity to make your analysis count.

What will I be doing?


Own analytical questions from initial problem definition through to insight and recommendation, using data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities and areas for action.
Deliver high quality analysis using tools including Python and SQL, applying appropriate statistical and modelling techniques to solve business problems.
Build clear and engaging Power BI reporting and visualisations that enable stakeholders to understand performance and make informed decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical requirements and confidently communicate findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, BI Developers and Data Engineering colleagues to develop insight led data products and ensure the quality and availability of the data underpinning your analysis.
Contribute to continuous improvement across the team by sharing knowledge, improving analytical approaches and looking for better ways to turn data into business value.


What do I need?


Demonstrable experience in an Insight Analyst, Data Analyst or comparable analytical role, with the capability to independently take ownership of problems and drive them towards a solution.
Strong hands-on Power BI experience, including creating reporting and visualisations that turn complex information into accessible and meaningful insight.
Strong communication and stakeholder partnering skills, with the confidence to explain complex analysis clearly, influence conversations and present insight to stakeholders at different levels of an organisation.
Practical coding and analytical experience using Python, alongside SQL skills and the confidence to work with large and complex datasets.
A sound understanding of analytical and statistical techniques, with exposure to modelling approaches such as regression, clustering or classification.
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the judgement to ask the right questions, challenge constructively and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.


Additional information

Benefits

We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including:


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays + holiday buying scheme
Worksave pension scheme with up to 7% employer contribution
Free AA breakdown membership from Day 1 plus 50% discount for family and friends
Discounts on AA products including car and home insurance
Employee discount scheme that gives you access to a car salary sacrifice scheme plus great discounts on healthcare, shopping, holidays and more
Company funded life assurance
Diverse learning and development opportunities to support you to progress in your career
Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme and a 24/7 remote GP service for you and your family


Plus, so much more!

We’re an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from everyone. The AA values diversity and the difference this brings to our culture and our customers. We actively seek people from diverse backgrounds to join us and become part of an inclusive company where you can be yourself, be empowered to be your best and feel like you truly belong. We have five communities to bring together people with shared characteristics and backgrounds and drive positive change.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Wise Platform Pricing
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Wise Platform Pricing Analytics team at Wise.

Wise Platform brings the reach and low cost of Wise to business partners - read more about Wise Platform here.

The Wise Platform Pricing Analytics team manages the pricing model and P&L analysis for Wise Platform. The team supports Wise Platform by calculating prices for partners, monitoring and reviewing the financial sustainability of the program, and finding opportunities to continue improving the growth and profitability of the company.

This is an IC2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

What You'll Be Doing


Identify and propose pricing and cost improvements for Wise Platform, ensuring solutions directly link to achieving profitability and growth outcomes
Investigate complex cost data, and influence improvements in upstream data quality and revenue and cost allocation methodologies within the Product Economics domain
Explain the underlying product economics that contribute to prices, and liaise with subject matter experts to gather detailed knowledge on economic drivers
Monitor and review the financial performance of Wise Platform, surfacing insightful and actionable insights on the main drivers of profitability
Contribute to improvements to the pricing model by applying knowledge of costs and cost drivers to appropriate pricing strategies


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in data analytics
Stakeholder management skills; you know how to influence teams to deliver high-impact change, across analytics, engineering, and business specialists
Extensive experience using SQL to build and maintain complex data sources, and leveraging visualisation tools to surface critical insights
Experience with dbt and robust data modelling, including the ability to navigate complex dbt projects and create reusable, maintainable data assets for scalable analytics


Nice To Have But Not Essential


Experience working on Pricing, especially B2B Pricing
Experience working in Fintech or Financial Services
Experience using Lightdash or Superset
Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques, including the use of Python and statistical modelling


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Work from (almost) anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year

Flexible working - you’re trusted to do the right thing and be responsible

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Annual Mission Days festival

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Middlesex / Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office

£40,000 - £60,000 + excellent benefits, depending on experience

Join a high-performing analytics team and make an impact at scale.




If you're an ambitious Data Analyst looking for more than just another reporting role, this could be an opportunity worth exploring.

Our client is a highly successful, globally recognised organisation with an established reputation in its sector and a genuinely exciting data agenda. With analytics playing an increasingly important role in how the business operates and makes decisions, they are investing heavily in their people, technology and capabilities.




You’ll join a large, multi-disciplinary Advanced Analytics function that operates almost like an internal consultancy - partnering with teams across the organisation, tackling complex business challenges and delivering insights that genuinely influence decision-making.




This isn't a role where you'll simply be handed a set of requirements and asked to produce a dashboard. You'll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge thinking, uncover opportunities and turn data into meaningful commercial insight.




Why join?




This is an opportunity to become part of a highly successful organisation that puts real investment behind its people and analytics capability.

You’ll benefit from:




• Working within a high-profile, established global organisation

• An internal consultancy-style environment, giving you exposure to a huge variety of business areas and challenges

• The opportunity to work alongside experienced Analytics Leads and talented analytical peers

• Exposure to advanced technologies, data and analytical techniques

• Significant opportunities to develop your technical and commercial skillset

• Regular interaction with stakeholders across the wider business, including senior decision-makers

• The chance to work on exciting, high-impact projects rather than simply maintaining BAU reporting

• A strong package of employee benefits, perks and rewards

• A collaborative culture where ideas are encouraged and analytical thinking is genuinely valued

• Hybrid working, with 3 days per week in the Middlesex office




The opportunity




The Advanced Analytics team is headed up by four Analytics Leads, each working across exciting and innovative projects for the wider business.

As a Data Analyst, you’ll work closely with one of these Leads and your fellow analysts, becoming a trusted analytical partner to different areas of the organisation.




You'll take complex business questions, understand what the data is telling you and turn that into clear, commercially relevant insight.

You'll have plenty of opportunity to build your stakeholder management skills, present your findings to a broad audience and develop your ability to communicate technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical people.




What you'll be doing




• Partner with core business areas to understand their data, reporting, visualisation and analytical requirements

• Work across a portfolio of dashboards, visualisations and data sources, driving their ongoing development and improvement

• Deliver robust and accurate datasets and visualisations within agreed timescales

• Structure complex problems and develop numerical models to support business decision-making

• Work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders, bringing people together and gaining buy-in for new ideas and approaches

• Use data to answer critical business questions and uncover meaningful insights

• Apply a range of analytical tools and technologies, including SQL, Tableau, Python and Excel

• Present your findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences




What we're looking for




We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about data and enjoys understanding the story behind the numbers.




You'll ideally have:




• At least 1 year's experience in a Data Analyst / Analyst position

• Strong SQL skills, alongside experience with Excel and Python (or similar)

• Experience working with large, complex or multiple datasets

• Experience designing and building dashboards and data visualisations, ideally using Tableau

• Experience analysing complex problems and turning findings into clear, actionable insights

• The ability to communicate analytical findings effectively to a broad stakeholder audience

• Experience managing databases and/or blending data from multiple sources

• Experience designing data structures for management information

• Strong presentation and communication skills

• The confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior audiences

• A creative, solutions-focused approach and a genuine desire to make things better




If you're looking for a role where you can broaden your commercial exposure, work on genuinely interesting problems, develop your technical toolkit and see the impact of your work across a successful global organisation, we'd love to hear from you.




Apply today for a confidential conversation and find out more.

For more information, please visit www.datatech.org.uk.

Company Description/ Business Unit

Location: Basingstoke (hybrid working 3 office days per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, full time

Additional Benefits: Annual Bonus

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

From roadside assistance to home and motor insurance, and the latest driving technologies, we have it all. As we continue to expand, diversify, and modernise, joining us as an Insight Analyst means you'll play a crucial role in our success and be part of this exciting motoring journey.

Our Chief Operating Office (COO) are the backbone of The AA, providing both stability and structure to support growth and innovation. We are the drivers of change.

This is the job

More than data. Be the insight behind the decision.

As an Insight Analyst at the AA, you will use data, analysis and technology to help our teams make better decisions for our customers and our business. This is a hands-on, mid-level role where you will take ownership of analytical challenges, uncover meaningful insight and turn it into clear recommendations that people can act on.

But this role is about more than what happens behind the screen. You will build trusted relationships with stakeholders, get close to the challenges facing the business, ask the right questions and confidently bring your insight into conversations with people at all levels. You will work across teams to influence thinking, solve problems and make a tangible difference, while continuing to grow your technical and commercial capability.

If you are an analyst who enjoys both the technical challenge of finding the answer and the human challenge of bringing people with you, this is an opportunity to make your analysis count.

What will I be doing?


Own analytical questions from initial problem definition through to insight and recommendation, using data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities and areas for action.
Deliver high quality analysis using tools including Python and SQL, applying appropriate statistical and modelling techniques to solve business problems.
Build clear and engaging Power BI reporting and visualisations that enable stakeholders to understand performance and make informed decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical requirements and confidently communicate findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, BI Developers and Data Engineering colleagues to develop insight led data products and ensure the quality and availability of the data underpinning your analysis.
Contribute to continuous improvement across the team by sharing knowledge, improving analytical approaches and looking for better ways to turn data into business value.


What do I need?


Demonstrable experience in an Insight Analyst, Data Analyst or comparable analytical role, with the capability to independently take ownership of problems and drive them towards a solution.
Strong hands-on Power BI experience, including creating reporting and visualisations that turn complex information into accessible and meaningful insight.
Strong communication and stakeholder partnering skills, with the confidence to explain complex analysis clearly, influence conversations and present insight to stakeholders at different levels of an organisation.
Practical coding and analytical experience using Python, alongside SQL skills and the confidence to work with large and complex datasets.
A sound understanding of analytical and statistical techniques, with exposure to modelling approaches such as regression, clustering or classification.
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the judgement to ask the right questions, challenge constructively and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.


Additional information

Benefits

We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including:


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays + holiday buying scheme
Worksave pension scheme with up to 7% employer contribution
Free AA breakdown membership from Day 1 plus 50% discount for family and friends
Discounts on AA products including car and home insurance
Employee discount scheme that gives you access to a car salary sacrifice scheme plus great discounts on healthcare, shopping, holidays and more
Company funded life assurance
Diverse learning and development opportunities to support you to progress in your career
Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme and a 24/7 remote GP service for you and your family


Plus, so much more!

We’re an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from everyone. The AA values diversity and the difference this brings to our culture and our customers. We actively seek people from diverse backgrounds to join us and become part of an inclusive company where you can be yourself, be empowered to be your best and feel like you truly belong. We have five communities to bring together people with shared characteristics and backgrounds and drive positive change.

Title: Senior Reporting Analyst
Description:
Why This Role Matters

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Online & Offline) strategy, to deliver trusted performance intelligence that enables better decision-making across our business. As a Senior Reporting Analyst, you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive the adoption of data driven activity and support profitable customer and commercial growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams and decision-makers across multiple functions, you will provide reporting, analysis and performance recommendations that influence strategic priorities and business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how data is used to unlock value, improve performance and accelerate growth in a fast-paced international retail environment, that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You’ll Be Doing


Create and maintain trusted reporting and performance dashboards that provide a clear, consistent view of customer, commercial and business performance across the organisation.
Analyse complex datasets to uncover trends, opportunities and risks, translating insight into clear recommendations that support better business decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across Group and Business Units to define, measure and align key performance indicators, ensuring performance is understood and acted upon consistently.
Drive the adoption of self-service reporting and analytics tools, enabling teams to independently access reliable insights and make data-led decisions with confidence.
Develop innovative reporting solutions using automation, AI and advanced analytics techniques to improve efficiency, scalability and the speed of insight generation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges, identify information gaps and deliver reporting that supports customer and commercial growth.
Continuously enhance reporting capabilities, data quality and user experience to strengthen performance visibility and maximise business impact.


What You’ll Bring


Proven experience in data analytics, ideally within eCommerce, digital or retail environments, with a minimum of three years’ experience turning complex data into actionable business insights.
Advanced expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), alongside strong SQL skills and experience developing scalable reporting solutions using Power BI, Looker and Excel.
A strong understanding of KPI governance, performance measurement frameworks and reporting standardisation within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
Commercially minded with the ability to identify trends, forecast performance and uncover opportunities that drive customer growth and business performance.
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights tailored to different audiences.
Demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders, building strong relationships across functions and driving the adoption of data-led decision-making.
A proactive and curious mindset, with experience delivering reporting transformation, automation or analytics innovation initiatives that improve efficiency and business outcomes.


How You Will Make An Impact


Empower colleagues across the business with trusted, accessible insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making and improve understanding of performance.
Drive a culture of data-led decision-making by increasing trust in reporting, strengthening KPI alignment and helping teams focus on what matters most.
Identify emerging opportunities and risks early, enabling the business to take proactive action that improves customer, commercial and operational outcomes.
Champion innovation by identifying new ways to leverage automation, analytics and AI to improve insight generation, efficiency and scalability.
Build strong relationships across functions, bringing people together around a shared understanding of performance and creating alignment behind key business priorities.
Simplify complexity by turning data challenges into practical solutions that improve reporting quality, accelerate decision-making and enhance organisational effectiveness.
Contribute to profitable growth by ensuring customer and commercial intelligence is translated into meaningful actions that deliver measurable business value.


Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme

Title: Data Analyst - Supply
Description:
Data Analyst (Supply)

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable participant marketplace is critical to meeting the growing demand for high-quality human data. To champion this effort, you will own analytics across the entire participant lifecycle, spanning acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, quality, retention, and reactivation.

Working hands-on with SQL and Python, you will build the metrics, dashboards, and experimentation frameworks that help us understand behavior and improve the participant experience. By partnering closely with Product, Operations, Growth, and Data Science, you will identify opportunities, structure experiments, and translate complex marketplace data into clear decisions that ensure participant health, marketplace liquidity, and long-term supply sustainability.

What you’ll bring to the role


Analytics Expertise: Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency (e.g. pandas, experimentation analysis, automation), with a track record of building scalable reporting frameworks in modern BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau). Comfortable owning problems end-to-end — from raw data to executive-ready insight.
Lifecycle Analytics: Experience analysing user acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, churn, and behavioural cohorts.
Experimentation & Statistics: Experience designing and analysing A/B or operational experiments, with solid grounding in statistical concepts and causal thinking.
Product Thinking: Ability to translate participant and marketplace challenges into measurable hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable recommendations.
Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to connect operational metrics to revenue, margin, and financial performance — understanding not just what is happening, but why it matters commercially.
Autonomy & Ownership: Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment, setting priorities, challenging assumptions, and driving initiatives from problem definition through implementation.
Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to partner across Product, Operations, Commercial, and Finance functions.
Marketplace Understanding: Strong grasp of B2B and two-sided marketplace metrics and economics.
Clear Communication: Ability to translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready insights that shape strategy and execution.


Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.
