Title: Senior/Staff Data Analyst
Description:
About MoonPay
MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:

Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100,

The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.
______________________________________________________________________________________________________

Locations Supported 🌍



London, UK (primary)
Remote (Europe)





Relocation available: Case by case

Work pattern:


Remote across Europe, with hybrid working encouraged if you're near a Moonbase (around 2 to 3 days per week in the London office).





About The Opportunity
In this role, you'll help shape MoonPay's product and business decisions through data, combining deep analysis, experimentation, and strong stakeholder partnership to drive real impact.

You'll sit within our centralised Product Data team and work closely with Product and Engineering, owning analytics across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems and success metrics through to launching, measuring, and optimising products at scale.

Your work will directly influence product strategy, customer experience, and business health, helping teams make better, faster decisions through trusted insights and clear narratives. You'll also raise the leverage of the whole team by building reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that let the wider org self-serve reliable answers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear direction, influencing decisions, and helping shape the future of high-impact financial and crypto products.

What You Will Do



Partner with product and business teams to run rigorous analysis (root cause, opportunity sizing, funnel drop-off) and turn it into clear, prioritised recommendations, moving across problem areas as priorities shift.
Define, document, and maintain clear metric definitions and business context, so stakeholders can understand the performance of their area and AI tools can interpret our metrics correctly (e.g. Transaction Success Rate, Fraud Rate).
Set up tracking and monitoring for new launches and changes, and quantify and measure their impact on KPIs.
Build and maintain a reporting layer, with automated alerting and root cause analysis that flags when KPIs move unexpectedly and why.
Design, run, and interpret experiments, from A/B tests to quasi-experimental methods like difference-in-differences when randomisation isn't possible.
Model robust, trusted data in our dbt and BigQuery layer, safeguarding its quality through testing, documentation, and certification in collaboration with engineering.
Create reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that scale the team's impact and help Product and Engineering self-serve.
Communicate complex concepts and findings to technical and non-technical audiences across different teams, while ensuring clarity and understanding to drive critical business decisions.





About You
Must-have experience and skills


5+ years of hands-on experience as a data analyst or data scientist, preferably in a product-focused role.
Advanced SQL and data visualisation are second nature to you.
Hands-on experience building data models in a modern cloud warehouse and transformation framework (e.g. dbt with BigQuery, Snowflake), with a strong instinct for data quality.
A solid grasp of statistics and probability, including experiment design and interpretation (A/B and quasi-experimental methods such as difference-in-differences).
A working understanding of how a payments or fintech business operates, including fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, and payment success rates.
Comfort using AI-assisted and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, and curiosity about building reusable skills that scale your impact.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder skills. You can distill complex findings for any audience up to C-level, and lead projects independently.





Nice-to-have Experience


Familiarity with our stack (dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Python) and AI tooling such as Claude Code.
Hands-on financial crime, payments, or fraud analytics experience.
Experience working in start-ups or scale-ups.





Bonus Points



A crypto-native perspective and experience with on-chain and blockchain data (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Chainalysis).
Experience making data self-serve for non-analysts (e.g. semantic layers, metric stores).

💰 Competitive salary package
🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay
📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

Title: Senior Insights Analyst
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.





Job Description



At Legal & General, we're building stronger insight-led decision making across our Institutional Retirement business. We're looking for a Senior Insights Analyst to help shape how performance data, reporting and operational insights support strategic decision making.



This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with strong analytical skills who enjoys solving problems, working with varied data sources and operating in an environment where they can genuinely influence how reporting and analytics evolve.



What you’ll be doing:



Developing and maintaining operational performance dashboards and reporting
Bringing together multiple data sources to create meaningful business insight
Supporting KPI, metric and OKR development across the COO function
Producing executive reporting for senior stakeholders
Analysing performance trends and identifying opportunities for improvement
Improving reporting processes and increasing automation where possible
Collaborating with business, change and data teams to meet reporting needs
Translating complex data into clear recommendations and actions

Who we’re looking for:



Experience using SQL to extract, manipulate and analyse data
Experience building reporting and visualisations using Power BI
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Experience developing KPIs, dashboards or performance reporting
Ability to work with multiple and evolving data sources
Strong stakeholder communication skills
Experience translating data into actionable business insight
Comfortable operating in changing and sometimes ambiguous environments

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This is a newly created role sitting at the intersection of Commercial Finance, Growth and Technology. The successful candidate will become the go-to person for turning raw data into reporting and trend analysis that drives commercial and growth decision-making across the business, spanning customer, membership, trade, and operational performance.

This role is being created at a pivotal moment. We are in a high growth stage, mid-migration to a new data warehouse, consolidating reporting across all of our systems. Today, extracting meaningful reporting requires heavy SQL work directly against individual data hubs. This person will play a central role in shaping the accuracy, structure, and reporting logic of the new data warehouse as it is finalised, acting as commercial and reporting-accuracy support on that project. Getting this right is fundamental to how fast and how well we make growth decisions as the business scales, so this directly underpins Growth, not just Technology.

Over time, there is a genuine opportunity for this role to grow, both in scope and, as the business scales, into a wider data and reporting team. This is a foundational hire.

You'll be mentored closely by the Commercial Finance and Strategy Director, who owns the Growth function and will steer commercial and growth priorities, while you bring the technical depth and cross-functional connection to make the data usable, trusted, and actionable.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting & Trend Analysis


Own, create and evolve regular reporting across customer, membership, trade, and operational performance
Build and maintain trend analysis that helps Commercial Finance and Strategic Growth and wider leadership understand business performance and emerging patterns
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, accurate data outputs
Define and track relevant KPIs for an ecommerce/app-based, membership-driven business


Data Warehouse Project


Partner across the reporting and data-accuracy voice within the data warehouse migration project, working closely with Technology
Support validating that the data structures, definitions, and outputs being built will meet commercial and finance reporting needs
Support the finalisation of the warehouse from an accuracy and usability standpoint, tracking progress, flagging risks, and helping ensure reconciliation and accuracy are maintained
Support the transition from current SQL-heavy, hub-by-hub reporting to a universally accepted data source used for strategic decision making by the SLT and management


Systems & Technical


Develop and maintain a strong working understanding of our current systems and data hubs, including the SQL required to extract and interpret data from them
Work confidently with SQL in the interim (pre-warehouse) environment, and help define reporting logic and data models for the future state
Flag data quality issues, inconsistencies, or gaps proactively

Title: Expression of Interest - YouTube Data Analyst
Description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.




YouTube is one of our biggest growth engines, home to some of the most distinctive channels, including LADbible Entertainment, LADbible Stories and SPORTbible. From working with the world’s biggest creators and A-list talent on hit formats like Snack Wars, to powerful storytelling through series such as Minutes With and Honesty Box, we’ve become one of the most exciting and influential players in the industry.




About the Role

Our YouTube team is growing, and we are on the proactive lookout for a Data Analyst. The Data Analyst produces insight that drives decisions across the YouTube team and informs the Originals commissioning pipeline.




What the opportunity looks like

Channel Performance - Analyse YouTube channel performance across watch time, CTR, audience retention, subscriber growth, CPMs, return viewers, and audience share to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Dashboard Management - Build, maintain, and optimise live reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and BigQuery, ensuring stakeholders have access to accurate, actionable performance data.
External Intelligence - Conduct competitive and market intelligence using tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, and platform analytics to benchmark performance and identify emerging category trends.
Format Growth and Analysis - Deliver audience, content format, and growth analysis to inform channel strategy, content investment decisions, and new channel or format opportunities.
Portfolio Growth Tracking - Monitor portfolio performance against targets, proactively flagging underperformance and providing data-driven recommendations to support business and commercial objectives.




Skills and experience we'd like you to have

Proven experience in data analytics or digital/media analytics, ideally within YouTube, social media, or digital publishing environments.
Experience analysing YouTube performance metrics, including watch time, audience retention, CTR, subscriber growth, RPM/CPM, and viewer behaviour.
Ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
Proficiency in BigQuery, SQL, Looker Studio, and data visualisation best practices.
Familiarity with competitive intelligence and social analytics tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, or similar platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 3 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

Title: IE Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Help shape smarter decisions through data and intelligence.

We're looking for an ambitious and analytical Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Data, Intelligence and Information Hub. This is an exciting opportunity to use data, insight and intelligence to support community safety, enforcement, licensing, CCTV and public protection services that make a real difference to residents and businesses.

As part of a dynamic and collaborative team, you'll work with colleagues across the Council, the police and external partners to transform complex data into meaningful intelligence. You'll identify trends, assess performance, uncover emerging risks and opportunities, and produce high-quality analytical products that inform both strategic and operational decision-making.

This role offers the chance to work on a diverse range of projects, using data from multiple sources to help tackle local challenges, improve services and support intelligence-led operations. You'll also have the opportunity to develop expertise in areas such as GIS analysis, performance management, enforcement intelligence and information governance.

We're looking for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, experience working with complex datasets, and the ability to communicate insights clearly and confidently to a variety of audiences. You'll be comfortable managing competing priorities, building effective relationships and working collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

In return, you'll join a forward-thinking team where your work will have a visible impact, helping to turn data into insight and insight into action.

If you're curious, data-driven and motivated by making a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. In this role, you will analyze data across our partner ecosystem—including sales performance, customer usage, licensing, and marketing—to provide insights into how our partners drive revenue growth, customer adoption, and long-term retention. Your work will help leadership make decisions on where to invest, which partners to prioritize, and how to grow our channel business effectively.

Key Responsibilities


Partner Performance Analysis Analyze how partners contribute to revenue growth, pipeline creation, and customer expansion across regions, channels, and segments.
Partner Health & Engagement Insights Develop lifecycle metrics and scorecards to assess partner effectiveness based on engagement, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and training participation.
Revenue & Forecasting Support Support reporting on recurring revenue (ARR), renewals, and pipeline, helping leadership understand growth trends and risks within the partner ecosystem.
Customer & Partner Relationship Insights Analyze how customers move between direct sales and partners, and identify opportunities for expansion and retention through partner channels.
Partner Marketing Analytics Measure the impact of partner-driven campaigns and initiatives on new partner acquisition and existing partner growth.
Predictive & Strategic Analysis Build models to identify high-growth partners, at-risk partners, and opportunities to improve partner coverage or investment.
Dashboarding & Executive Reporting Create clear, executive-ready dashboards and insights that help sales, marketing, and partner teams take action.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales/Go-To-Market, Partner Programs, Marketing, RevOps, and Finance to align on metrics, reporting, and business priorities.


Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment, with a focus on customer data analytics. Experience in SaaS B2B performance metrics such as Annual Recurring Revenue, Net Recurring Revenue, and Gross Recurring Revenue analysis is a plus.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) a must. Experience with customer systems such as CRM systems (e.g., Dynamics CRM, PRMs), Gainsight CS, Everstage Commission, Segment Marketing, DealHub, OutReach, and Zoominfo experience are also a plus.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data handling and analysis.
Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and customer success processes and how data can inform strategy and decision-making.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

Title: Claims Data Analyst
Description:
About Zego



At Zego, we understand that traditional motor insurance holds good drivers back. It's too complicated, too expensive, and it doesn't reflect how well you actually drive. Since 2016, we have been on a mission to change that by offering the lowest priced insurance for good drivers.

From van drivers and gig workers to everyday car drivers, our customers are the driving force behind everything we do. We've sold tens of millions of policies and raised over $200 million in funding and picked up numerous awards, including the Insurance Claims Team Of The Year 2024 as awarded at The Insurance Post's Claims & Fraud Awards. And we're only just getting started.

Purpose of the role



We're looking for a proactive and analytical Claims Data Analyst to help us enhance our Claims and Fraud operations, shaping one of the most vital areas of the insurance industry.

As part of a fast-growing, product-led tech company, you'll play a key role in driving impactful change within our rapidly scaling Claims team. Your insights will power strategic decision-making, improve efficiency, and uncover opportunities for continuous improvement. Expect to work on developing insightful reports and dashboards, collaborating closely with Claims and Fraud teams, and delivering data-backed recommendations to leadership and stakeholders across the business.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-centric environment and are eager to make a real difference in the evolution of claims operations, we'd love to hear from you!

What you will be doing


Design & build core data models and reporting to support Claims and Fraud operations
Develop key reports for senior stakeholders, including Zego leadership, investors, and insurance partners
Analyze performance & identify trends, uncovering key drivers to optimise processes
Spot and size opportunities for continuous improvement, tracking the impact of initiatives
Support strategic decision-making for the Claims and Fraud leadership team
Translate data into compelling stories—delivering actionable insights to senior management
Collaborate cross-functionally, supporting Claims, Fraud, Pricing, and external reporting needs
What you will need to be successful


Got a degree? Great! If not, equivalent experience works too (bonus points if it's in a STEM subject)
SQL Skills - You know your way around data extraction and manipulation like a pro
Power BI Expertise - You've built data models, reports, and dashboards before and can turn raw numbers into something meaningful
Data Storytelling - You can take complex insights and turn them into clear, engaging stories that senior stakeholders (think senior managers, investors, Zego's board, and insurance partners) actually understand
Insurance Know-How (Nice to have!) - If you understand the motor insurance market and what drives commercial performance, that's a big plus
Claims & Financial Acumen (Nice to have!) - Familiarity with claims processes, reserving, and settlements? Even better
Actuarial & Reserving Knowledge (Nice to have!) - If you can be the go-to person between Claims, Fraud, and Actuarial teams, we'd love to have you on board!
What's it like to work at Zego?



Joining Zego is a career-defining move. People go further here, reaching their full potential to achieve extraordinary things. 

We're spread throughout the UK and Europe, and united by our drive to get things done. We're proud of our company and our culture - a friendly and inclusive space where we can lift each other up and celebrate our wins every day.

Together, we're setting the bar higher, delivering exceptional work that makes a difference. Our people are the most important part of our story, and everyone here plays a role. There's loads of room to learn and grow, and you'll get the freedom to steer your career wherever you want.

You'll work alongside a talented group who embrace each other's differences and aren't afraid of a challenge. We recognise our achievements, learn from our mistakes, and help each other to be the best we can be. Together, we're making insurance matter. 

Our approach to AI



We believe in the power of AI to meaningfully improve how we work - helping us move faster, think differently, and focus on what matters most. At Zego, we encourage people to stay curious and intentional about how AI is leveraged in their work and teams to drive practical impact every day. This is your chance to do the most meaningful work of your career - and we'll provide you with the tools, support, and freedom to do it well.

How we work



We believe that teams work better when they have time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid.

Our hybrid way of working is unique. We foster a flexible approach that empowers every Zegon to perform at their best. We ask you to spend at least one day a week in our central London office (next to Liverpool Street). We cover the costs for all company-wide events (3 per year), and also provide a separate hybrid contribution to help pay towards other travel costs. We think it's a good mix of collaborative face time and flexible home-working, setting us up to achieve the right balance between work and life.

Benefits



We reward our people well. Join us and you'll get a market-competitive salary, private medical insurance, company share options, generous holiday allowance, and a whole lot of wellbeing benefits. And that's just for starters.

About Zego

At Zego, we understand that traditional motor insurance holds good drivers back. It's too complicated, too expensive, and it doesn't reflect how well you actually drive. Since 2016, we have been on a mission to change that by offering the lowest priced insurance for good drivers.

From van drivers and gig workers to everyday car drivers, our customers are the driving force behind everything we do. We've sold tens of millions of policies and raised over $200 million in funding and picked up numerous awards, including the Insurance Claims Team Of The Year 2024 as awarded at The Insurance Post's Claims & Fraud Awards. And we're only just getting started.

Purpose of the role

We're looking for a proactive and analytical Claims Data Analyst to help us enhance our Claims and Fraud operations, shaping one of the most vital areas of the insurance industry.

As part of a fast-growing, product-led tech company, you'll play a key role in driving impactful change within our rapidly scaling Claims team. Your insights will power strategic decision-making, improve efficiency, and uncover opportunities for continuous improvement. Expect to work on developing insightful reports and dashboards, collaborating closely with Claims and Fraud teams, and delivering data-backed recommendations to leadership and stakeholders across the business.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-centric environment and are eager to make a real difference in the evolution of claims operations, we'd love to hear from you!

What you will be doing

  • Design & build core data models and reporting to support Claims and Fraud operations
  • Develop key reports for senior stakeholders, including Zego leadership, investors, and insurance partners
  • Analyze performance & identify trends, uncovering key drivers to optimise processes
  • Spot and size opportunities for continuous improvement, tracking the impact of initiatives
  • Support strategic decision-making for the Claims and Fraud leadership team
  • Translate data into compelling stories—delivering actionable insights to senior management
  • Collaborate cross-functionally, supporting Claims, Fraud, Pricing, and external reporting needs
What you will need to be successful

  • Got a degree? Great! If not, equivalent experience works too (bonus points if it's in a STEM subject)
  • SQL Skills - You know your way around data extraction and manipulation like a pro
  • Power BI Expertise - You've built data models, reports, and dashboards before and can turn raw numbers into something meaningful
  • Data Storytelling - You can take complex insights and turn them into clear, engaging stories that senior stakeholders (think senior managers, investors, Zego's board, and insurance partners) actually understand
  • Insurance Know-How (Nice to have!) - If you understand the motor insurance market and what drives commercial performance, that's a big plus
  • Claims & Financial Acumen (Nice to have!) - Familiarity with claims processes, reserving, and settlements? Even better
  • Actuarial & Reserving Knowledge (Nice to have!) - If you can be the go-to person between Claims, Fraud, and Actuarial teams, we'd love to have you on board!
What's it like to work at Zego?

Joining Zego is a career-defining move. People go further here, reaching their full potential to achieve extraordinary things. 

We're spread throughout the UK and Europe, and united by our drive to get things done. We're proud of our company and our culture - a friendly and inclusive space where we can lift each other up and celebrate our wins every day.

Together, we're setting the bar higher, delivering exceptional work that makes a difference. Our people are the most important part of our story, and everyone here plays a role. There's loads of room to learn and grow, and you'll get the freedom to steer your career wherever you want.

You'll work alongside a talented group who embrace each other's differences and aren't afraid of a challenge. We recognise our achievements, learn from our mistakes, and help each other to be the best we can be. Together, we're making insurance matter. 

Our approach to AI

We believe in the power of AI to meaningfully improve how we work - helping us move faster, think differently, and focus on what matters most. At Zego, we encourage people to stay curious and intentional about how AI is leveraged in their work and teams to drive practical impact every day. This is your chance to do the most meaningful work of your career - and we'll provide you with the tools, support, and freedom to do it well.

How we work

We believe that teams work better when they have time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid.

Our hybrid way of working is unique. We foster a flexible approach that empowers every Zegon to perform at their best. We ask you to spend at least one day a week in our central London office (next to Liverpool Street). We cover the costs for all company-wide events (3 per year), and also provide a separate hybrid contribution to help pay towards other travel costs. We think it's a good mix of collaborative face time and flexible home-working, setting us up to achieve the right balance between work and life.

Benefits

We reward our people well. Join us and you'll get a market-competitive salary, private medical insurance, company share options, generous holiday allowance, and a whole lot of wellbeing benefits. And that's just for starters.

Title: Insight Analyst
Description:
Company Description/ Business Unit

Location: London (hybrid working 3 office days per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, full time

Additional Benefits: Annual Bonus

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

For over a century, we've been evolving and adapting. Today, as the nation's leading motoring organisation, we offer a wide range of products and services to millions of customers. From roadside assistance to home and motor insurance, and the latest driving technologies, we have it all. As we continue to expand, diversify, and modernise, joining us as an Insight Analyst means you'll play a crucial role in our success and be part of this exciting motoring journey.

Our Chief Operating Office (COO) are the backbone of The AA, providing both stability and structure to support growth and innovation. We are the drivers of change.

This is the job

More than data. Be the insight behind the decision.

As an Insight Analyst at the AA, you will use data, analysis and technology to help our teams make better decisions for our customers and our business. This is a hands-on, mid-level role where you will take ownership of analytical challenges, uncover meaningful insight and turn it into clear recommendations that people can act on.

But this role is about more than what happens behind the screen. You will build trusted relationships with stakeholders, get close to the challenges facing the business, ask the right questions and confidently bring your insight into conversations with people at all levels. You will work across teams to influence thinking, solve problems and make a tangible difference, while continuing to grow your technical and commercial capability.

If you are an analyst who enjoys both the technical challenge of finding the answer and the human challenge of bringing people with you, this is an opportunity to make your analysis count.

What will I be doing?


Own analytical questions from initial problem definition through to insight and recommendation, using data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities and areas for action.
Deliver high quality analysis using tools including Python and SQL, applying appropriate statistical and modelling techniques to solve business problems.
Build clear and engaging Power BI reporting and visualisations that enable stakeholders to understand performance and make informed decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical requirements and confidently communicate findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, BI Developers and Data Engineering colleagues to develop insight led data products and ensure the quality and availability of the data underpinning your analysis.
Contribute to continuous improvement across the team by sharing knowledge, improving analytical approaches and looking for better ways to turn data into business value.


What do I need?


Demonstrable experience in an Insight Analyst, Data Analyst or comparable analytical role, with the capability to independently take ownership of problems and drive them towards a solution.
Strong hands-on Power BI experience, including creating reporting and visualisations that turn complex information into accessible and meaningful insight.
Strong communication and stakeholder partnering skills, with the confidence to explain complex analysis clearly, influence conversations and present insight to stakeholders at different levels of an organisation.
Practical coding and analytical experience using Python, alongside SQL skills and the confidence to work with large and complex datasets.
A sound understanding of analytical and statistical techniques, with exposure to modelling approaches such as regression, clustering or classification.
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the judgement to ask the right questions, challenge constructively and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.


Additional information

Benefits

We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including:


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays + holiday buying scheme
Worksave pension scheme with up to 7% employer contribution
Free AA breakdown membership from Day 1 plus 50% discount for family and friends
Discounts on AA products including car and home insurance
Employee discount scheme that gives you access to a car salary sacrifice scheme plus great discounts on healthcare, shopping, holidays and more
Company funded life assurance
Diverse learning and development opportunities to support you to progress in your career
Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme and a 24/7 remote GP service for you and your family


Plus, so much more!

We’re an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from everyone. The AA values diversity and the difference this brings to our culture and our customers. We actively seek people from diverse backgrounds to join us and become part of an inclusive company where you can be yourself, be empowered to be your best and feel like you truly belong. We have five communities to bring together people with shared characteristics and backgrounds and drive positive change.

Title: Commercial Data Analyst
Description:
Role: Commercial Data Analyst

Location: Hybrid - 3 days per week Clapham Junction

This is a genuine opportunity to work across the full breadth of a fast-moving consumer business - from gym trading performance and location strategy through to product and customer behaviour - and to produce analysis that directly shapes how The Gym Group grows. If you have around two years of analytics experience and you are ready to take on more ownership, work with senior stakeholders and build your commercial instincts, this role has a lot to offer.

Who We Are

We're not like any other gym company; we are The Gym Group, a place where you can #BeYouWithUs and perform to your absolute best. We are successful; by membership we're the 2nd largest gym business in the UK and the 4th largest in Europe. We hire people with real passion, positivity and enthusiasm which motivates and inspire those around them. We actively invest in our employees; it's so important to us that our people can thrive in our environment and can make the most of the flexibility and support we offer to all of our teams.

What You'll Be Doing


Analysing trading performance across our gym estate and surfacing insights that help the business act quickly and confidently
Supporting member acquisition and retention analysis, helping the business understand what drives membership growth and how to reduce churn
Working with our Property team to analyse location performance and inform decisions about where we open and invest
Evaluating product performance and member behaviour to help the Product team improve the experience we offer
Building dashboards and reports that give stakeholders a clear view of performance in their area
Answering ad hoc business questions end to end - from scoping the brief through to presenting findings
Communicating insights clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues in a way that leads to action


What We're Looking For


Around 2 years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a commercial environment
Strong, independent SQL skills - you should be comfortable writing and troubleshooting queries without support
Confidence using Excel for data analysis and manipulation
A proven ability to communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience building reports, dashboards or data visualisations that support decision making
Strong attention to detail and a proactive, curious approach to problem solving


Our commitment to inclusion

At The Gym Group, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and able to be themselves. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you are excited by this role but do not meet every requirement listed, we would still encourage you to apply - we care about potential and attitude as much as experience.

Need assistance?

If you have a disability or condition that makes it difficult for you to complete your application online please email your cv to recruitment@thegymgroup.com or alternatively call the TGG Recruitment team on 0203 319 4838 and someone will be more than happy to support you. We also want to put it out there that we actively encourage applications from a diverse demographic and we are passionate about your culture and value alignment. We want this to be a match that works for you as much as for us!


Please note that we may close the application window early if we receive high levels of interest. If you're interested in applying please do so asap!


Your application may be reviewed by an AI tool to help assess your suitability based on the information you provide. Automated decision-making is never used - every application is reviewed and all decisions, including whether to progress your application, are made exclusively by a member of our recruitment team. Your data will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and UK GDPR. If you have any questions about how your information is used, please contact recruitment@thegymgroup.com.

Title: BI Data Analyst
Description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About The Role

We are looking for a BI Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. You will take ownership of analytical projects end-to-end — from scoping business problems through to insight delivery — working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Finance, Product, Commercial and Operations. You will build and maintain critical dashboards and reporting, surface trends and anomalies in business performance, and use data storytelling to drive measurable business outcomes. You will be expected to leverage AI tools strategically throughout your workflow — from LLM-assisted query generation and analysis summarisation to code review — accelerating delivery while maintaining rigorous standards. You will also provide critical support as the human-in-the-loop to ensure accuracy and repeatability of data analysis in other functions, empowering all our teams to make full use of AI-driven data self-serve

What Will You Do


Take business problems and independently structure them into well-defined analytical tasks
Own KPI monitoring and reporting for embedded stakeholder teams, ensuring data accuracy to build quality and confidence in your outputs
Root cause and explain in detail data discrepancies, finding solutions to stakeholder problems
Build Looker dashboards and Hex notebooks to support deep-dive analysis and stakeholder self-serve
Write production-quality SQL and Python, following team coding standards and passing peer review. Additionally assist others to review AI generated outputs.
Communicate insights and recommendations clearly — constructing narratives that drive action
Use AI tools to improve workflow (e.g. query generation, analysis drafts, documentation) while maintaining quality and accuracy
Work with Analytics Engineers to ingest new data sources into the stack as needed


Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.


Competitive salary
Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success
25 days holiday
Flexible working (2 days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore)
Private medical insurance via BUPA
Life assurance
Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)
Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)
24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
EV leasing scheme
Cycle to work scheme
Nursery salary sacrifice scheme
1 paid volunteering day a year


Applications close Monday 24th August.

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Department: Data

Location: London



Description

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to build and own the central view of company performance, proactively identify shifts and find strategic opportunities to improve growth, profitability and efficiency. We're looking for someone who is highly curious with a bias to action, combining strong technical skills with excellent communication and business sense.

Key Responsibilities


Work with stakeholders across the business to build out central company-level monitoring that drives decisions.
Define and proactively monitor KPIs to identify performance shifts.
Lead strategic deep-dives to identify opportunities to improve YouLend.
Turn business insights into an actionable plan and build senior stakeholder alignment around it.
Raise the bar on analytical standards across the company (testing, dashboard design, documentation, storytelling, etc.).


Skills, Knowledge & Expertise


5+ years in an analytics role.
Examples of working with cross-functional groups of stakeholders to drive alignment on metric definitions then building the central monitoring for core KPIs.
A track record of identifying strategic opportunities and shaping the narrative for the business.
Previous experience in a fast-paced ambiguous environment.
Able to mentor and upskill other analysts and business stakeholders.
Skills
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Experience building impactful dashboards.
Strong analytical thinking with a solid knowledge of applied statistics.
Familiarity with dbt and analytics engineering best practices.


Job Benefits

Why join YouLend?
Award-Winning Workplace: YouLend has been recognised as one of the “Best Places to Work in 2024, 2025 and 2026” by the Sunday Times for being a supportive, diverse, and rewarding workplace.
Award-Winning Fintech: YouLend has been recognised as a “Top 250 Fintech Worldwide” company by CNBC.


It's just getting fun
We have developed powerful solutions, secured significant partnerships, and are growing rapidly.
The global opportunity is still massive, and YouLend is a raw organisation where we are only just getting started.


Lots of upsides
High-growth (>100% growth during 2022 and 2023), so clear outlook to compensation (bonus or share option appreciation) and career growth (through growth with the business).
Well-capitalised with supportive private equity backing.
Part of Banking Circle Group with a fully licensed Luxembourg bank, which can provide a balance sheet and support European expansion in otherwise complex regulated markets.


Motivating work environment
A high-quality team that pushes each other to succeed through direct feedback and aligned incentives.
Strong, transparent team culture: we have each other’s backs.
Independent work environment where results matter.
Data-driven culture and emphasis on speed (anti-red tape).


We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
Private Medical Insurance (via Vitality)
EAP with Health Assured
Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
Great office space (including a gym!) in Central London
Subsidised lunch (via Feedr)
Deliveroo allowance if working late in the office
Monthly in-office masseuse
Team and Company socials
Sports clubs


At YouLend, we champion diversity and embrace equal opportunity employment practices. Our hiring, transfer, and promotion decisions are exclusively based on qualifications, merit, and business requirements, free from any discrimination based on race, gender, age, disability, religion, nationality, or any other protected basis under applicable law.

Middlesex / Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office

£40,000 - £60,000 + excellent benefits, depending on experience

Ref: J13172




Join a high-performing analytics team and make an impact at scale.




If you're an ambitious Data Analyst looking for more than just another reporting role, this could be an opportunity worth exploring.

Our client is a highly successful, globally recognised organisation with an established reputation in its sector and a genuinely exciting data agenda. With analytics playing an increasingly important role in how the business operates and makes decisions, they are investing heavily in their people, technology and capabilities.




You’ll join a large, multi-disciplinary Advanced Analytics function that operates almost like an internal consultancy - partnering with teams across the organisation, tackling complex business challenges and delivering insights that genuinely influence decision-making.




This isn't a role where you'll simply be handed a set of requirements and asked to produce a dashboard. You'll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge thinking, uncover opportunities and turn data into meaningful commercial insight.




Why join?




This is an opportunity to become part of a highly successful organisation that puts real investment behind its people and analytics capability.

You’ll benefit from:




• Working within a high-profile, established global organisation

• An internal consultancy-style environment, giving you exposure to a huge variety of business areas and challenges

• The opportunity to work alongside experienced Analytics Leads and talented analytical peers

• Exposure to advanced technologies, data and analytical techniques

• Significant opportunities to develop your technical and commercial skillset

• Regular interaction with stakeholders across the wider business, including senior decision-makers

• The chance to work on exciting, high-impact projects rather than simply maintaining BAU reporting

• A strong package of employee benefits, perks and rewards

• A collaborative culture where ideas are encouraged and analytical thinking is genuinely valued

• Hybrid working, with 3 days per week in the Middlesex office




The opportunity




The Advanced Analytics team is headed up by four Analytics Leads, each working across exciting and innovative projects for the wider business.

As a Data Analyst, you’ll work closely with one of these Leads and your fellow analysts, becoming a trusted analytical partner to different areas of the organisation.




You'll take complex business questions, understand what the data is telling you and turn that into clear, commercially relevant insight.

You'll have plenty of opportunity to build your stakeholder management skills, present your findings to a broad audience and develop your ability to communicate technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical people.




What you'll be doing




• Partner with core business areas to understand their data, reporting, visualisation and analytical requirements

• Work across a portfolio of dashboards, visualisations and data sources, driving their ongoing development and improvement

• Deliver robust and accurate datasets and visualisations within agreed timescales

• Structure complex problems and develop numerical models to support business decision-making

• Work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders, bringing people together and gaining buy-in for new ideas and approaches

• Use data to answer critical business questions and uncover meaningful insights

• Apply a range of analytical tools and technologies, including SQL, Tableau, Python and Excel

• Present your findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences




What we're looking for




We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about data and enjoys understanding the story behind the numbers.




You'll ideally have:




• At least 1 year's experience in a Data Analyst / Analyst position

• Strong SQL skills, alongside experience with Excel and Python (or similar)

• Experience working with large, complex or multiple datasets

• Experience designing and building dashboards and data visualisations, ideally using Tableau

• Experience analysing complex problems and turning findings into clear, actionable insights

• The ability to communicate analytical findings effectively to a broad stakeholder audience

• Experience managing databases and/or blending data from multiple sources

• Experience designing data structures for management information

• Strong presentation and communication skills

• The confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior audiences

• A creative, solutions-focused approach and a genuine desire to make things better




If you're looking for a role where you can broaden your commercial exposure, work on genuinely interesting problems, develop your technical toolkit and see the impact of your work across a successful global organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. In this role, you will analyze data across our partner ecosystem—including sales performance, customer usage, licensing, and marketing—to provide insights into how our partners drive revenue growth, customer adoption, and long-term retention. Your work will help leadership make decisions on where to invest, which partners to prioritize, and how to grow our channel business effectively.

Key Responsibilities


Partner Performance Analysis Analyze how partners contribute to revenue growth, pipeline creation, and customer expansion across regions, channels, and segments.
Partner Health & Engagement Insights Develop lifecycle metrics and scorecards to assess partner effectiveness based on engagement, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and training participation.
Revenue & Forecasting Support Support reporting on recurring revenue (ARR), renewals, and pipeline, helping leadership understand growth trends and risks within the partner ecosystem.
Customer & Partner Relationship Insights Analyze how customers move between direct sales and partners, and identify opportunities for expansion and retention through partner channels.
Partner Marketing Analytics Measure the impact of partner-driven campaigns and initiatives on new partner acquisition and existing partner growth.
Predictive & Strategic Analysis Build models to identify high-growth partners, at-risk partners, and opportunities to improve partner coverage or investment.
Dashboarding & Executive Reporting Create clear, executive-ready dashboards and insights that help sales, marketing, and partner teams take action.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales/Go-To-Market, Partner Programs, Marketing, RevOps, and Finance to align on metrics, reporting, and business priorities.


Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment, with a focus on customer data analytics. Experience in SaaS B2B performance metrics such as Annual Recurring Revenue, Net Recurring Revenue, and Gross Recurring Revenue analysis is a plus.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) a must. Experience with customer systems such as CRM systems (e.g., Dynamics CRM, PRMs), Gainsight CS, Everstage Commission, Segment Marketing, DealHub, OutReach, and Zoominfo experience are also a plus.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data handling and analysis.
Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and customer success processes and how data can inform strategy and decision-making.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

Title: Data Analyst III (Product)
Description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

We are seeking a Data Analyst III to join our growing data organization in the enterprise reporting team. This data analyst plays a key role in developing and maintaining enterprise reporting frameworks. This role focuses on report creation, data modeling, transformation, and validation while ensuring compliance with internal governance. This developer helps bridge the gap between data engineering and analytics, ensuring that high-quality, reliable data is available for decision-making. This developer plays a key role in creating executive dashboards and reports that clearly communicate KPIs and strategic insights to leadership.

About Fanatics Markets (FMX)

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

Responsibilities


Design dashboards with a long-term mindset, ensuring they are optimized, scalable, and maintainable for evolving business needs.
Experience working in a product-driven environment, partnering directly with product managers and engineering teams to influence product decisions — strongly preferred
Maintain and continuously update dashboards, ensuring data accuracy, performance, and alignment with evolving business needs.
Enhance and refresh existing BI assets, incorporating new data sources, business logic, and stakeholder feedback to keep reports relevant and actionable.
Assist in data governance activities, including metadata management and reporting documentation.
Design, build, and maintain scalable data models that support reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics.
Support data modeling, transformation, and automation to improve reporting efficiency.
Assist in gathering and refining reporting requirements from finance, compliance, and business teams.
Conduct data validation, reconciliation, and quality control checks to maintain reporting integrity.
Develop processes to streamline data extraction, transformation, and reporting workflows.
Support automated reporting solutions to reduce manual effort and enhance reporting consistency.
Investigate and reconcile reporting variances across reports, ensuring consistency and accuracy of KPIs.
Work with stakeholders to identify root causes of discrepancies and implement fixes in data models or dashboards.
Generate and maintain reports on key business metrics for governance, financial, and operational performance.
Effectively communicate findings and insights to product managers, developers, and other stakeholders through clear reports and presentations.


Qualifications


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar role.
Advanced SQL skills
Data modeling utilizing a tool such as DBT, including
Manage and optimize source code control in GitHub, leveraging branching strategies and best practices to ensure efficient collaboration and code quality
Experienced with building dashboards and reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, Looker).
Customer obsessed and experience focused; highly outcome-oriented and data-driven; experienced in working in high-growth environments.
Demonstrated ability to partner closely with stakeholders, earning trust and prioritizing relationships.
Logical and analytical approach to problem solving. Plus for utilizing AI in analytics.
Strong organizational and communication skills.
Positive and flexible attitude, a willingness to embrace new initiatives.
Understanding of sports betting or experience in customer behavior analysis is a significant plus.
Must be open to travel for team offsites and events.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This is a newly created role sitting at the intersection of Commercial Finance, Growth and Technology. The successful candidate will become the go-to person for turning raw data into reporting and trend analysis that drives commercial and growth decision-making across the business, spanning customer, membership, trade, and operational performance.

This role is being created at a pivotal moment. We are in a high growth stage, mid-migration to a new data warehouse, consolidating reporting across all of our systems. Today, extracting meaningful reporting requires heavy SQL work directly against individual data hubs. This person will play a central role in shaping the accuracy, structure, and reporting logic of the new data warehouse as it is finalised, acting as commercial and reporting-accuracy support on that project. Getting this right is fundamental to how fast and how well we make growth decisions as the business scales, so this directly underpins Growth, not just Technology.

Over time, there is a genuine opportunity for this role to grow, both in scope and, as the business scales, into a wider data and reporting team. This is a foundational hire.

You'll be mentored closely by the Commercial Finance and Strategy Director, who owns the Growth function and will steer commercial and growth priorities, while you bring the technical depth and cross-functional connection to make the data usable, trusted, and actionable.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting & Trend Analysis


Own, create and evolve regular reporting across customer, membership, trade, and operational performance
Build and maintain trend analysis that helps Commercial Finance and Strategic Growth and wider leadership understand business performance and emerging patterns
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, accurate data outputs
Define and track relevant KPIs for an ecommerce/app-based, membership-driven business


Data Warehouse Project


Partner across the reporting and data-accuracy voice within the data warehouse migration project, working closely with Technology
Support validating that the data structures, definitions, and outputs being built will meet commercial and finance reporting needs
Support the finalisation of the warehouse from an accuracy and usability standpoint, tracking progress, flagging risks, and helping ensure reconciliation and accuracy are maintained
Support the transition from current SQL-heavy, hub-by-hub reporting to a universally accepted data source used for strategic decision making by the SLT and management


Systems & Technical


Develop and maintain a strong working understanding of our current systems and data hubs, including the SQL required to extract and interpret data from them
Work confidently with SQL in the interim (pre-warehouse) environment, and help define reporting logic and data models for the future state
Flag data quality issues, inconsistencies, or gaps proactively


Cross-Functional Communication


Act as a translator between technical/data concepts and commercial stakeholders across the business
Build relationships with teams outside Finance and Tech to understand their reporting needs and pain points
Present findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical audiences, including SLT


Essential

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


Strong SQL skills and confidence working directly with data hubs/systems rather than pre-built dashboards alone
Proven experience building reporting and trend analysis in a commercial or finance context
Excellent communication skills, able to work equally well with Technology and with non-technical commercial teams
A genuine interest in and understanding of KPIs relevant to an ecommerce/app-based business
Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity. This is a new role in a business that is actively building its data infrastructure
Self-starter mentality with the judgement to know when to lead and when to seek guidance from the Commercial Finance Director


Desirable (not Essential, But a Strong Plus)


Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
Experience in fashion, luxury fashion, membership, or subscription-based businesses
Exposure to data warehouse migrations or reporting infrastructure projects
Experience with BI/visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker, Tableau)


WHY THIS ROLE


A rare opportunity to shape both the reporting output and the underlying data infrastructure of a growing luxury fashion group
Direct mentorship and close working relationship with the Commercial Finance Director
Genuine potential to grow this role into a team as the business scales
Visibility across customer, membership, trade, and operational functions. This role is central to how the business understands itself


Benefits

Why Join MILE


Opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of the company.
Collaborative and innovative work environment.
Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organisation.


Let’s build something people talk about. Together.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
Description:
About The Team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We’re looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You’ll help answer questions such as:


Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?


If you’re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do


Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.


You’ll be great for this role if…


You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
You’ve worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
You’re proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
You’re comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
You’re curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
You’re comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.


This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

As a GTM Data Analyst at sunday, your ultimate goal will be to make our go-to-market performance easier to understand, measure, and improve. You will become an expert in sunday’s data architecture and reporting infrastructure, helping teams across the US, UK, and France turn complex business questions into clear, actionable insight. Join early, grow fast, and shape the journey!

Serve as the primary analytics resource for GTM operators across the US, UK, and France, delivering complex analyses and ad hoc deep dives.

Design and maintain dashboards covering account and territory views, opportunity management, activity, and pipeline analysis.
Query and model data directly in SQL and BigQuery to answer questions beyond out-of-the-box Salesforce reporting.
Maintain data integrity and reporting consistency across regions, systems, and tools.

You have 2–4 years of experience in a data analyst or similar analytics role.

Exposure to go-to-market, sales, or revenue operations environments.

Prior exposure to building or using AI or agentic workflows in a business context.
