Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This is a newly created role sitting at the intersection of Commercial Finance, Growth and Technology. The successful candidate will become the go-to person for turning raw data into reporting and trend analysis that drives commercial and growth decision-making across the business, spanning customer, membership, trade, and operational performance.

This role is being created at a pivotal moment. We are in a high growth stage, mid-migration to a new data warehouse, consolidating reporting across all of our systems. Today, extracting meaningful reporting requires heavy SQL work directly against individual data hubs. This person will play a central role in shaping the accuracy, structure, and reporting logic of the new data warehouse as it is finalised, acting as commercial and reporting-accuracy support on that project. Getting this right is fundamental to how fast and how well we make growth decisions as the business scales, so this directly underpins Growth, not just Technology.

Over time, there is a genuine opportunity for this role to grow, both in scope and, as the business scales, into a wider data and reporting team. This is a foundational hire.

You'll be mentored closely by the Commercial Finance and Strategy Director, who owns the Growth function and will steer commercial and growth priorities, while you bring the technical depth and cross-functional connection to make the data usable, trusted, and actionable.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting & Trend Analysis


Own, create and evolve regular reporting across customer, membership, trade, and operational performance
Build and maintain trend analysis that helps Commercial Finance and Strategic Growth and wider leadership understand business performance and emerging patterns
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, accurate data outputs
Define and track relevant KPIs for an ecommerce/app-based, membership-driven business


Data Warehouse Project


Partner across the reporting and data-accuracy voice within the data warehouse migration project, working closely with Technology
Support validating that the data structures, definitions, and outputs being built will meet commercial and finance reporting needs
Support the finalisation of the warehouse from an accuracy and usability standpoint, tracking progress, flagging risks, and helping ensure reconciliation and accuracy are maintained
Support the transition from current SQL-heavy, hub-by-hub reporting to a universally accepted data source used for strategic decision making by the SLT and management


Systems & Technical


Develop and maintain a strong working understanding of our current systems and data hubs, including the SQL required to extract and interpret data from them
Work confidently with SQL in the interim (pre-warehouse) environment, and help define reporting logic and data models for the future state
Flag data quality issues, inconsistencies, or gaps proactively


Cross-Functional Communication


Act as a translator between technical/data concepts and commercial stakeholders across the business
Build relationships with teams outside Finance and Tech to understand their reporting needs and pain points
Present findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical audiences, including SLT


Essential

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


Strong SQL skills and confidence working directly with data hubs/systems rather than pre-built dashboards alone
Proven experience building reporting and trend analysis in a commercial or finance context
Excellent communication skills, able to work equally well with Technology and with non-technical commercial teams
A genuine interest in and understanding of KPIs relevant to an ecommerce/app-based business
Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity. This is a new role in a business that is actively building its data infrastructure
Self-starter mentality with the judgement to know when to lead and when to seek guidance from the Commercial Finance Director


Desirable (not Essential, But a Strong Plus)


Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
Experience in fashion, luxury fashion, membership, or subscription-based businesses
Exposure to data warehouse migrations or reporting infrastructure projects
Experience with BI/visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker, Tableau)


WHY THIS ROLE


A rare opportunity to shape both the reporting output and the underlying data infrastructure of a growing luxury fashion group
Direct mentorship and close working relationship with the Commercial Finance Director
Genuine potential to grow this role into a team as the business scales
Visibility across customer, membership, trade, and operational functions. This role is central to how the business understands itself


Benefits

Why Join MILE


Opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of the company
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organisation


Let's build something people talk about. Together.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
Description:
About The Team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We’re looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You’ll help answer questions such as:


Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?


If you’re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do


Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.


You’ll be great for this role if…


You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
You’ve worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
You’re proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
You’re comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
You’re curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
You’re comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.


This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of over 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 600 of the biggest companies in the UK.




By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl.




Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We are named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year 2018, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.




Your role in our mission

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Data Analyst to be a driving force within our Enterprise Data Hub. Reporting to the Lead Enterprise Data Analyst, you will move beyond reactive reporting to become a Performance Engineer for Salary Finance, helping us accelerate our business objectives. You will be responsible for building the "Platinum-rated" datasets that serve as our company's Source of Record, enabling us to safely scale our loan book to £1bn+.




As a senior member of the team, you will be a high-visibility advocate for data excellence. You will work closely with stakeholders across all departments to foster a company-wide culture of data ownership. This is a high-impact role at the heart of our 2026 strategy. You won't just be fulfilling requests; you will be architecting the data framework that allows our Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to self-serve with absolute confidence building trust throughout the organisation. Your mission is to ensure that the intelligence powering our most critical objectives is governed, trusted, and actionable.




What you’ll do

Architect High-Impact Dashboarding:

You will liaise with stakeholders of all data literacy levels to develop robust dashboard requirements
You will build, design, develop and maintain best-in-class Power BI dashboards which serve a purpose and deliver value to the business
You will define and enact best practice UX/UI design across the dashboards to ensure user engagement in dashboarding

Drive Operational Efficiency

You will lead the automation of manual reporting processes and end-to-end operational workflows, ensuring high uptime and seamless maintenance of production reports.
You will regularly audit existing report performance and SQL scripts to reduce technical debt and improve processing speeds as data demand scales.

Influence Strategic Direction:

You will provide deep-dive analytics and data-driven insights that directly shape long-term business strategy and commercial outcomes.

Champion Data Integrity:

You will act as a custodian of data excellence by implementing and maintaining rigorous data governance standards and documentation across all analytical outputs.

Engineer Data Foundations:

You will build optimised scalable data products and robust data marts, creating a structured environment for self-service analytics.
You will collaborate with Enterprise Data Engineers to refine ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring the upstream data architecture supports downstream analytical requirements.

Leadership & Collaboration:

You will act as a data & analytics mentor across the business and lead training sessions for business users to increase self-service adoption and data-driven decision-making.
You will lead the code-review process for SQL and DAX to ensure team-wide adherence to logic accuracy and performance standards.




About you

Essential:

Proven Track Record: At least 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or similar roles, with a demonstrable history of progressing from technical execution to strategic delivery.
Advanced SQL Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in writing, optimising, and debugging complex queries. You should be comfortable handling large-scale datasets and understanding relational database architecture.
Power BI & DAX Specialist: Advanced command of the Power BI ecosystem. You don't just build reports; you create sophisticated DAX measures and perform complex data modeling to solve intricate business logic.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: A proven ability to act as a bridge between technical data and business needs. You can translate "vague requests" into concrete technical requirements and present findings to executives with confidence.
Insight Delivery & Storytelling: You possess a "so what?" mindset. You have a track record of moving beyond descriptive reporting to deliver predictive insights that drive measurable commercial value.
LLM Literate: You are comfortable using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to accelerate your workflow, whether for logic verification, documentation, or streamlining code development.
Technical Mentorship: Experience in peer-reviewing code (SQL/DAX) and coaching junior analysts to uphold high standards of accuracy, performance, and design




Nice to have:

Experience in financial services or a similar regulated industry (e.g., FinTech, banking).
Prompt Engineering for Data: You are well-versed in prompt engineering techniques to optimise data cleaning, generate SQL scripts, or automate metadata documentation.
Python for Analytics: Ability to use Python for data manipulation (Pandas/NumPy), automation scripts, or basic statistical modeling to augment standard BI toolsets.
Data Governance Frameworks: Practical experience establishing data dictionaries, lineage, and quality protocols to ensure a "single source of truth."
Forecasting & Predictive Modeling: Experience building time-series forecasts or predictive models to help the business anticipate trends, demand, or churn.




Who you are

We embrace our differences, but there’s one thing we like to share, which is our values, so it’s important to us that you are:

Fearless, and able to make the impossible possible.
Responsible, and want to help build a business that delivers a meaningful difference to society.
Dedicated and want to commit to an exciting journey even through the highs and lows.
Empathetic and truly care about every colleague and customer.
United, because you understand we achieve more when we work as a team.
Humble, and take feedback as a way to continuously improve.




What do you get for all your hard work?

Company bonus scheme 💰
25 days holiday with an additional day off for every year of service up to 30 days and an extra day off on your birthday 🎂
Hybrid working arrangements so you can work from the office and from home with a budget to help you get set up 🏠
Generous company benefits to include pension and life assurance and an annual allowance to spend on medical insurance, health cash plan, denplan, gym memberships 🤸
Enhanced policies that are family and pet friendly, to include company sick pay and peternity leave 🐶
Great career development in a fast paced environment 🚀
Regular company socials (post covid, although we've got quite good at virtual ones too!)
Volunteer days as part of our CSR program 🤝
More great perks to include weekly snacks, tuckshop, cycle to work, help to save and much more! 🍭




The typical interview process

Introductory call with our Talent Manager (phone call - 20 mins)
1st Stage: Technical interview (PowerBI exercise) with Hiring Manager and team (video call - 60 mins)
2nd Stage: Past work experience and culture interview with Hiring Manager and team (in person - 60 mins)




We’re looking for people that will get stuck in and make a difference. We have a great collaborative, entrepreneurial team and are passionate about what we do. If you want to join a team that is changing people’s lives for the better then we’d love to hear from you.




Learn more at salaryfinance.com




Salary Finance is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where all employees and applicants can flourish.




If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Content
Description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

What you’ll work on

You'll be embedded with our content team, working directly with editors to turn engagement and coverage data into the decisions that shape what we publish. Sitting within the analytics team alongside our analysts and analytics engineers, you'll own content analytics end-to-end, from instrumentation through to the insight that changes editorial strategy.


Build engagement measurement beyond readership. Define and instrument the signals that reveal an article's true value; time on page, scroll depth, click-through.
Separate genuine engagement from passing interest. Build tag-effectiveness analysis and LLM-based content classification so editors can see what actually resonates.
Measure core and public audiences. Quantify engagement for our core subscriber base (client value) and broader public reach (demand generation), across content, social and video.
Power data-driven coverage prioritisation. Surface the highest-attention companies and situations so editorial resource hits the most contentious, market-moving stories.
Track competitive coverage and story attribution. Monitor coverage gaps, timeliness and accuracy versus competitors, and attribute market-moving stories to 9fin.
Explain what's moving the numbers. Diagnose spike drivers and build reproducible analysis frameworks rather than one-off dashboards.
Own content datasets and the semantic layer. Author dbt models on BigQuery and own the Omni semantic layer so the newsroom gets fast, trustworthy, self-serve answers.
Be the embedded analytical partner to the newsroom. Work directly with editors, translating content questions into analysis that shapes editorial strategy and helps us build a better distressed product than the competition.


About You

You're a senior, hands-on individual contributor with real technical depth who's excited to sit inside a newsroom and use data to shape what gets covered and how.


Proven analytics experience, ideally in media, B2B SaaS or fintech, owning analysis end-to-end and driving real decisions.
Expert SQL for complex analysis, optimisation and reusable datasets.
dbt & a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or similar) — commercial experience building production models, tests and docs.
Modern BI with an integrated semantic layer — building self-serve dashboards and owning metric definitions (e.g. Omni, Looker, Thoughtspot).
Engagement and event analytics — designing tracking/instrumentation and analysing behavioural signals, with the statistical judgement to separate signal from noise.
Fluent with AI tools — building LLM-based pipelines to classify and analyse content at scale.
A strong communicator who turns analysis into clear narratives editors and leadership can act on.
Curious and a fast learner — comfortable grasping distressed-market concepts within a few explanations; a background blending data and storytelling is a real plus.
Finance or distressed-debt knowledge is a plus, not essential.
Bonus: content, web, SEO, social or audience/growth analytics; Python for deeper analysis.


Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance


Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)
Equity options
Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)
Private Medical Insurance
Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness
Group Life Assurance
Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes


Time off


25 holiday days per year
Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)
Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work
Work abroad for up to 3 months a year
1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service
Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available


Training & Culture


Professional learning and development budget
Quarterly team socials
Summer and Winter company social events


9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

Title: Ralph Lauren Data Analyst, Digital Commerce, EMEA & LATAM
Description:
Company Description

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

Position Overview

Key role in the EMEA E-commerce analytics team ensuring they will deliver insights, reporting, and advanced analytics to drive business decisions and support optimizing the digital customer journey, customer services, and performance marketing. You will solve complex business problems / challenges through data analytics and will story-tell the actionable insights to the key stakeholders to drive and encourage data-driven decision making. You will build key relationships with internal and external stakeholders, Digital Commerce associates and other analysts around the business - becoming an SME for one of the Digital teams i.e. Performance Marketing, and will own and maintain that dialogue whilst also pro-actively delivering innovative and creative analytics in that space.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


Develop a reporting suite that clearly and accurately demonstrate ROI and profitability, from campaigns, collections, customer journeys, digital product, and merchandise product perspective using Adobe, Microstrategy tools, across a range of metrics that cover all stages of the consumer journey, transactions and voice of the customer interactions.
Creation and maintenance of reports and dashboards using web analytics data and data visualisation tools, with the ambition to automate all reporting across the business, whilst monitoring the core KPIs vs. targets.
Proactively seek to solve complex business problems/challenges through data analytics and will translate data into actionable insights and drive data-driven decision making.
Play a key role in the experimentation process and UX improvements through A/B & MVT tests
Monitor competitors' activities and provide updates on best cases and market trends.
Become the E-commerce team's analytics power user, promoting tool awareness and capability (adobe)
Monitor competitors' activities and provide updates on best cases and market trends.
Liaise with appointed external agencies who are supporting digital analytics.
Perform QA testing on web analytics tracking implementations to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
Conduct validation of tagging, data layers, and event tracking across Adobe and other analytics tools.
Partner with developers and product teams to identify and resolve tracking issues before release.
Create and maintain QA testing checklists and documentation to standardize validation processes.
Support A/B test setup with pre- and post-launch QA to verify correct experiment configuration and data collection.


Experience, Skills & Knowledge


A strong quantitative university degree or equivelant ( e.g. statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering)
Strong experience in retail analytics, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights and communicate recommendations through clear, impactful storytelling for business stakeholders.
Experience of actively using data visualization tools and enterprise Business Intelligence tools
Outstanding analytical skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken
Experience of building scalable reporting and analytics
Experience of using relational databases and data mining tools
Adobe Analytics / Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, PowerBI, SQL, Databricks

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Main Duties:

Reporting to the Manager of Customer Relationship Management & Marketing Technology, this position will analyze, manage, customize, and optimize SIGA’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. The Data Analyst will collaborate with various departments to ensure the CRM system aligns with business goals, enhances customer interactions, and contributes to the organization’s success.




Responsibilities

Title: Data Analytics Coordinator
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Analytics Coordinator plays a supporting role as a steward of PRPA's data warehouses, from data ongestion through to the creation and maintenance of reports. They are responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of data used for various activities from infrastructure planning to business development.

Position Accountabilities


PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.
Load data assets into PRPA’s data warehouses following best practices.
Support and maintain PRPA’s data warehouse.
Maintenance of reports and dashboards.
Training of PRPA staff in end user reporting tools available for accessing PRPA’s data.


WORKING CONDITIONS


Works predominantly in an office environment.
Regular, full-time position (37.5 hours per week). Regular working hours are Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 1 hour unpaid lunch break.


JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Formal Education


College diploma in Analytics, Computer Science Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology.


Related Experience


Three to five years' experience in the industry


Other Requirements


Experience with reporting tools and software including SSRS, PowerBI, Informatica.
Experience with SSIS or other data ingestion and transformation tools.
Experience using Safe FME for processing geospatial data.
Experience with report writing, organizing, and presenting data in support of decision making
Demonstrates statistical and empirical analytical skills
Knowledge of relational database structures, theories, principles, and practices is an asset
Knowledge of ETL methodologies, T-SQL and ArcGIS is an asset
Familiar with the transportation and logistics industry
Demonstrates ability to learn new skills and acquire industry knowledge
Good spoken and written communication skills
Strong problem solving and organizational skills
Accuracy and attention to detail, with an analytical eye
Superior judgment and tact in dealing with sensitive issues and confidential information.
Demonstrates ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and to effectively handle changing priorities.
Enthusiastic and self-motivated. Works well individually as well as in a team environment.
Creative and intuitive thinker.
Demonstrates commitment to the Port’s Vision.
Resilient. Embraces change and thrives on change.
Proficient in MS Office, especially Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint; some exposure to MS Access and Project.
Able to obtain security clearance under Transport Canada's Security Clearance Program.


The base salary range for this role is $77,689 - $97,112. This position is eligible for a performance-based variable incentive targeted at 10% of the base salary.

We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels a sense of belonging and can contribute to their maximum potential. Our differences are the reason great things happen here. If you are an applicant in need of accommodation or special assistance throughout the interview process, please submit a request by email to careers@rupertport.com.

Individuals of Indigenous descent are strongly encouraged to apply.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Ignite Your Potential. Impact What Matters.

Hi, we’re HUB – a network of doers with diverse stories and a shared goal to support our clients and communities. To do it, we believe in supporting each other, because great work happens when people come together, and that means building a team where anyone can spark an idea, and where everyone can make a difference. Where pushing ourselves forward helps us give more to others.

When you partner with us, you’re at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you’re ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly skilled Data Analyst with strong, hands-on experience in Applied Epic and Power BI to join our team. This role is central to maintaining, structuring, and leveraging data from Applied Epic to support operational decision-making, business performance tracking, and strategic initiatives across the organization. The successful candidate will take ownership of data quality metrics, build and maintain Power BI reporting infrastructure, develop Epic automation, and drive system efficiencies. Demonstrated expertise in Applied Epic's data structure and reporting capabilities, combined with advanced Power BI skills, is essential to success in this role. This is a great opportunity for someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, and excited about transforming insurance and brokerage data into actionable, visual business intelligence.

What You'll Do


Extract, analyze, and interpret data directly from Applied Epic, using advanced knowledge of its data structure, tables, and relationships to support business reporting and analytics
Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that present KPIs and operational metrics to stakeholders at all levels of the organization
Develop and manage data models and ETL processes connecting Applied Epic to Power BI, ensuring scalable, reliable, and efficient reporting solutions
Build and maintain Epic automation (including VBA-based tools and scripts) to streamline data extraction, reduce manual processes, and improve system efficiency
Establish and enforce data quality and validation processes to ensure accuracy and consistency across all Applied Epic-sourced reports and downstream systems
Write and optimize queries (SQL and/or Epic-native reporting tools) to support ad hoc and recurring reporting needs
Partner with underwriting, finance, operations, and leadership teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into effective Power BI solutions
Support projects involving the migration, integration, or optimization of Applied Epic data with other business platforms (e.g., finance systems, CRM, data warehouses)
Maintain documentation of data definitions, report logic, and dashboard structures to support long-term data governance
Stay current on Applied Epic updates/releases and Power BI features to continuously improve reporting capabilities


What We're Looking For


Required: Significant hands-on experience working directly within Applied Epic, specifically in data extraction, reporting, and analysis
Required: Strong, proven experience with Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and building interactive dashboards from scratch
Required: Proficiency in SQL and Power Query (other query languages an asset)
A background in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field is considered an asset
Proficiency in VBA coding for automation and process improvement
Solid understanding of data modeling principles, particularly as they apply to reporting, dashboard integration, and Epic's underlying schema
Experience in the insurance or brokerage industry is a strong asset
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a sharp eye for accuracy and detail
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable working within Windows-based systems and standard business applications (Microsoft Office suite, etc.)
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects independently in a fast-paced environment


Why Join HUB?


An exceptional, welcoming, and inclusive company culture
Excellent compensation, benefits, RRSP match, referral incentives, and company perks
Work flexibility
Paid educational training and vast learning opportunities
Room for advancement and growth within the organization
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!
Diversity, Inclusion and Community Groups to connect employees


What makes us different than all the rest?

Our Vision: To be everywhere risk exists – today and tomorrow. Helping protect what matters most.

Our Mission: To protect and support the aspirations of individuals, families, and businesses. To empower our employees to learn, grow and make a difference in their communities.

Our Core Values


Entrepreneurship: We encourage innovation and educated risk-taking
Integrity: We do the right thing every time
Teamwork: We work together to maximize results
Accountability: We measure and take responsibility for outcomes
Service: We serve clients, communities, and colleagues


Ready to join HUB and build a career in a rapidly growing industry? Apply today!

Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.


Job Skills

Technical skills


SQL (writing queries, joins, CTWs, optimization)
Microsoft Windows and Windows Server Operating Systems
Microsoft Azure
Cloud Platforms
Microsoft 365 Suite
Online Exchange
Windows Virtual Desktop
SharePoint
Networking and Security
System and Network Configuration
Virtualization
Backup and Disaster Recovery
Technical Documentation
Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
Monitoring and Performance Optimization
Regulatory Knowledge
Security Best Practices


Interpersonal & Communication Skills


Customer Service
Verble and Written Communication
Collaboration and Teamwork
Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
Adaptability
Project Management and Organizational Skills


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field, or MIS, or directly relevant experience can be considered in lieu of the required degree.
Four years of demonstrated related work experience. Experience with Microsoft with Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop; Exchange Online, Office 365; SharePoint, Azure Files Services; Azure Active Directory, Windows Service management, and document management and workflow automation software.
Experience administering local and cloud-based computer hardware and telecommunications functions is strongly preferred.
Extensive experience in Yardi required.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Title: ERP Data Specialist
Description:
Who We Are

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.

After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.

We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.

What You Can Expect


Health and Dental - Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
Manulife Virtual Pharmacy - Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services - Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
Life and Disability - You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
Pension Matching Program - Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
Wellness Reimbursement Program - Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
Personal and Professional Development - We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
Community Involvement - Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.


Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation


Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.


Reporting Continuity & Analysis


Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.


Data Triage & Corporate Alignment


Proactively identify, analyze, and triage all data-related requests from users, assessing their scope, impact, and urgency.
Provide timely support for data and reporting requests within the capabilities of the existing platform whenever possible.
Collaborate with the corporate team to evaluate complex data requirements or system gaps, escalating issues as needed to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards and maintain KPI consistency across all plants.
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand their specific data requirements and ensure the requirements are met during and after the IFS commissioning.


Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess:


Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Proven experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
Experience working in an IFS environment is considered an asset.
Strong proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and an ability to learn new ERP data structures quickly.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to "connect the dots" between data and real-life operations.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented mindset to support and train non-technical users.
Ability to triage requests, manage multiple priorities, and act as a bridge between plant needs and corporate standards.
Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn new business processes and data systems.
Strong affiliation with Price’s core values


Should this excellent opportunity interest you, please submit your resume, including salary expectations.

We appreciate the interest shown by all applicants, however only those being considered for an interview will be contacted.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

Title: Analytics Developer
Description:
A Little Bit About Us

Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Since launching in 2019, our goggles have earned global recognition, including Red Dot, iF Design, and Global Triathlon awards, and are trusted by professional athletes, age-group triathletes, and swimmers looking to get better.

We're a talented, tight-knit team that's fun to work with and serious about building great products. Together, we bring decades of consumer product experience spanning sports eyewear, interface design, and activity-tracking algorithms.

To learn more, visit formswim.com

Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced Analytics Developer to strengthen FORM's analytics data foundation and business intelligence capabilities. Working primarily in SQL, dbt, Amazon Redshift and Tableau, you will transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce and financial data into trusted, reusable models and translate those models into clear, decision-ready dashboards and visualizations. This is a hands-on role for someone who can contribute quickly, take ownership of production work and leave well-tested, documented systems and intuitive reporting behind.

Primary Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable SQL and dbt models in Amazon Redshift
Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets
Define and maintain consistent business metrics, including revenue, MRR, churn, retention, trial conversion, customer lifetime value and sales performance
Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products


Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications


3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling
Hands-on experience building, testing and documenting production data models with dbt

Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams

Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools

Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required


Data Modeling & Documentation


Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes
Operational Excellence


Automation


Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting


DevOps


Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps


Quality


Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review
Data Governance & Standards


Governance & Compliance


Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)


Data Standards


Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices
Other
Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply


Operational Excellence


Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports


Analytical Skills


Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques


Communication Skills


Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions

StarTech.com is continuing to grow our Data Analytics team and we are looking for a Data Analyst who is passionate about turning data into actionable insights.

In this role, you will partner closely with cross functional teams to analyze data across key areas of the business, including product performance, inventory, revenue, customer insights, and marketing. Your work will help shape business decisions, optimize performance, and support continued growth.

You will be responsible for transforming data from multiple sources into clear, meaningful insights, building models, and delivering reporting that informs strategy. Success in this role comes from strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate insights in a way that drives action.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with data tools such as Power BI, Python, R, or Excel, and collaborating with stakeholders to influence outcomes, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Posting this opportunity to support a backfill requirement on the team

Analyze key business metrics to evaluate and improve strategic initiatives
Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations
Build data models and generate summary statistics using analytics tools
Develop reports and dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Power BI)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business needs
Communicate insights clearly to stakeholders at all levels
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve efficiency
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Technology, or related field (Master’s in Analytics is an asset)
2+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role working with large datasets
Strong experience with Power BI and Power Query
Advanced Excel skills
Intermediate proficiency in Python or R
Experience or interest in AI tools and applications

What Sets You Apart

Strong data cleaning, transformation, and analysis skills
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights
Experience building queries, reports, and visualizations
High attention to detail and accuracy
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
A proactive learner who is curious, adaptable, and driven to improve processes

Why Join StarTech.com?

Competitive salary and bonus potential
Comprehensive benefits package
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Opportunities to grow your skills in analytics, BI, and AI

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

Intro call with our Talent Acquisition Team (30 minutes)
Assessment (60 minutes)
Interview with the Hiring Manager (45-60 minutes)
Final Interview - Director, Market Research & Analytics (45 minutes)
Offer & onboarding

This role offers a competitive salary range of CAD $68,000 to $78,000 and eligibility to participate in our bonus program. At StarTech.com, we value fairness and regularly benchmark pay to stay competitive, recognizing each person’s unique contributions.

As part of the StarTech.com “One Team,” you’ll also enjoy:

Comprehensive health benefits
Tuition reimbursement program
Retirement savings plans
Wellness Program
Additional perks and rewards

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!


$73,300 - $91,600 a year

The typical hiring range listed above is specific to candidates located in Vancouver. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join!

If you’re interested in the position but your expectations don’t fully align with the provided range, we still encourage you to apply! Considerations may be made based on your experience level.
