Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.




How we’ll make you feel at Home

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.




This job posting is for an existing vacancy within our organization.




Bring your unique skills, thrive with interesting and challenging work, and experience what it’s like at Home. Apply today - this is a great opportunity to join a proudly Canadian company that is 100% ready to help you build your future.




Home Hardware recognizes the value of a diverse team. We believe that different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences make us stronger as an organization. Applicants representing the full diversity of communities in Canada are encouraged to apply with confidence. Please let us know if you require accommodation during the recruitment process.

Title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
Description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist bridges the gap between operational data and real-world execution. This role is responsible for analyzing courier, customer, and partner performance data to uncover hidden inefficiencies, designing structured "test and learn" pilots, and validating proof-of-concepts before they are scaled across global markets. The ideal candidate thrives on turning complex data into actionable recommendations and running live experiments in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Ultimately, this role is critical to optimizing our global logistics footprint, directly impacting courier satisfaction, cost efficiency, and customer loyalty.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Opportunity Identification
Analyze operational performance data and key performance indicators (including courier utilization, complaints, and delivery reliability) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and service risks.
Quantify and articulate specific areas of opportunity across courier experience and support touchpoints.
Partner with data teams to enhance dashboards and reports (utilizing tools like Tableau or SQL) to back all improvement initiatives with hard data.
Lead process improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost reduction.
Facilitate process mapping, root cause analysis, Kaizen events, and problem-solving workshops.
Pilot Execution & Experimentation
Develop and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across all courier experience and courier support touchpoints, ensuring cohesive plans, ongoing measurement and impact to couriers and team members
Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.
Drive a globalised and aligned approach while adapting for local needs
Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.
Monitor, validate, and report on the realized benefits, cost-effectiveness, and productivity impacts of all implemented pilot programs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Scaling
Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience: 3–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, business analysis, operations management, or logistics.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Strong analytical thinking with a data-driven approach ; experience using Tableau, SQL, or other data analytics tools is highly preferred.
Methodologies: Practical experience with Lean principles, root cause analysis, and project management practices.
Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills ; independent thinker who is proactive and highly comfortable navigating ambiguity.


Why work at Skip?

Skip is the kind of workplace that garnered a “Top Places to Work in Manitoba” and it was no small coincidence. We set out to make this a place our employees are proud to tell their Mothers, Fathers, friends and anyone who will listen that they work here. Skip team members feel pride knowing their input and uniqueness are not only embraced but make an impact on a major Canadian company and its satisfied customers. As the company grows, so do you — you meet and surpass new challenges every day. That’s just a small taste of what it’s like to work at one of Canada’s leading tech companies. If you’re hungry for opportunity, growth, and something meaningful in a dynamic, fun and challenging environment, we’d love to hear from you.

SKIP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where all employees feel they truly belong and where everyone is included, seen, heard and respected.

In keeping with our values, all applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of: gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital/domestic partner status, (dis)ability, neurodivergence, or any other characteristic protected by law. Should you require any accommodations throughout the hiring process, we encourage you to reach out to your talent acquisition specialist.

Note


All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.

Title: Database Analyst
Description:
Branch: Electric

Affiliation: MoveUP

Employment Status: Full-Time Regular

Salary: $4,134.00 Biweekly

Short-term Incentive Eligible: No

Workplace Flexibility: No

Posting End Date: Open until filled

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Responsibilities


Analyzes and translates business information requirements into logical database designs; develops the data infrastructure that best supports the business; maps data models to existing data design interfaces; conducts performance tuning and optimization.
Works with system developers to develop data models, design alternatives and approaches; reviews and revises estimates for design and implementation activities.
Monitors data base performance using various monitoring tools and develops solutions with application teams and software vendors to address and resolve performance issues for medium to large databases; monitors the growth of data bases and performs further tuning as required; analyzes operational problems and data base recoveries to determine and implement problem fixes.
Reviews technical infrastructure for single points of failure and evaluates the business requirements to ensure high availability for application, database and network systems.
Works closely with the application developer and operations teams as needed to complete the application fail-over and recovery strategy; makes recommendations for disk storage configurations.
Develops, communicates, and maintains the data architecture and data models at the conceptual, logical, and physical levels; presents the data and database architectures to project teams; coordinates work to apply data models to existing databases.
Interfaces with development team members and management to develop, upgrade, optimize and troubleshoot the database systems as required in a SQL Server and Oracle environment.
Participates in the development of enterprise data architecture, policies, standards and guidelines related to the system wide integration of data.
Evaluates and selects tools to support data modeling and design; identifies, evaluates and recommends technologies to support the database architecture.
Identifies issues of data ownership across the enterprise, including data integration issues for consolidation and transformation.
Provides direction, guidance, and technical support to clients, applications, and operations areas; co-ordinates production turnover procedures with operations and application maintenance personnel.
Performs other duties of a minor nature related to the above responsibilities, which do not affect the evaluation of the job.


Requirements


Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
A minimum of five (5) to six (6) years of related experience in database administration with a thorough working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle database design and implementation.
Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle database administration experience with a thorough knowledge of database design principals; competence in conceptual, logical, and physical database design.
Expertise in designing data architecture, selecting appropriate technologies and products and designing an implementation approach.
Competence in managing medium to large size database projects with multiple subprojects, system interfaces and specialized functions, which span across several business units.


In this role, you may have the option to participate in a flexible work program, enabling you to work from an approved flex location in British Columbia up to 85 days a year (equivalent to approximately two days a week), subject to business or operational needs.

Our engaging workplace offers a wide range of challenging opportunities, while being safe, inclusive, and diverse. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, while supporting life-long career development. We also encourage volunteerism and nourish the need to give back to your community.

Subject matter expertise in data analytics and statistical modelling

Title: Manager, Data and Analysis
Description:
Organization: SaskMilk

Location: Regina, SK

Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Reports To: Senior

Salary Range: $85,776 - $111,492

Position Overview

The Manager, Data and Analysis is responsible for collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and reporting data related to milk production, quota management, producer payments, market trends, and dairy industry performance. The role supports evidence-based decision-making, regulatory reporting, and strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, validate, maintain, and analyze dairy industry, production, and financial data.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics.
Monitor milk production, quota utilization, producer shipments, and market demand.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reports for management and stakeholders.
Support forecasting related to milk production, transportation, demand, and revenue.
Create data visualizations using Power BI or similar tools.
Analyze quota, production, and market information to support regulatory programs.
Support reporting requirements for provincial and national dairy organizations.
Assist with producer payment calculations and verification processes.
Maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across systems.
Identify and resolve data quality issues.
Develop reporting procedures, business rules, and documentation.
Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders.
Support board reporting, strategic planning, and industry analysis.


Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience with Power BI, or data visualization tools.
Experience using SQL and relational databases.


Definite Assets


Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis.
Experience in agriculture, dairy, agri-food, or commodity marketing.
Knowledge of dairy industry regulations and quota systems.


Skills & Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in data analysis, modelling, and interpretation.
Ability to work with datasets related to quota, production, transportation and market trends.
Experience with tools such as Excel (advanced) and Power BI.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate complex analytical findings into accessible language.
High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable working both independently and in a collaborative team environment.


Attributes


Evidence-driven, curious, and committed to continuous improvement.
Professional, diplomatic, and capable of handling sensitive or complex issues.
Adaptable and solution-oriented with sound judgment.
Dedicated to supporting the sustainability and success of Saskatchewan’s dairy sector.


What We Offer


A dynamic and challenging work environment.
A competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package, including a pension.
Various leave options, including vacation, scheduled days off (SDO), and family/personal leave.
Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.


Criminal Record Check Requirement

The successful candidate shall be subject to a Criminal Record Check as a condition of employment.

Closing Date

The closing date for applications is August 13, 2026; however, the competition will remain open until a suitable candidate has been appointed.

Selection Procedure

We thank all applicants however only those selected for an interview will be contacted by email.

Title: Vineyard Business Analyst
Description:
Winemaking in some major regions of the world can be an ‘industrial’ undertaking, but for us here at Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, every decision in the vineyard has a direct impact on the quality of what ultimately ends up in the bottle.

Exceptional vineyards require more than great farming practices. They require clear insights, strong operational discipline, and the ability to understand the story behind the data.

Our vineyards generate vast amounts of information every season, from labour and productivity metrics to purchasing activity, operational costs, vineyard performance trends, and planning data. The opportunity is no longer collecting data. It is transforming that information into meaningful insights that help our teams make better decisions.

The Role

As our Vineyard Business Analyst, you will play a critical role in helping us better understand, measure, and optimize the performance of our vineyard operations. Sitting at the intersection of data, operations, finance, and viticulture, you will transform complex operational information into actionable insights that improve productivity, strengthen cost visibility, and support decision-making across our vineyards. This is a highly collaborative role that combines business analysis, operational reporting, procurement support, and data visualization. You will work closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, and finance partners to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and build reporting tools that provide clarity across vineyard operations. More than a reporting role, this is an opportunity to bring a fresh perspective, challenge assumptions with data, and help shape how vineyard performance is measured and managed for years to come.

Productivity & Performance Analytics


Measure and monitor vineyard productivity, labour efficiency, and operational performance across activities, blocks, sites, and seasons.
Analyze key operational metrics including hours per acre, cost per activity, labour utilization, and year-over-year performance trends.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Translate complex operational data into practical recommendations that vineyard leadership can act on.
Support annual planning processes through productivity benchmarking, workforce analysis, and operational forecasting.
Develop meaningful performance indicators that help leaders understand operational effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.


Data Visualization & Reporting


Design and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into vineyard performance and operational health.
Transform data from multiple operational systems into meaningful business insights.
Develop reporting frameworks that allow teams to proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Present data in a clear and compelling way, helping stakeholders understand the story behind the numbers.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across vineyard reporting processes.
Create visualizations that simplify complex datasets and support informed decision-making at all levels of the organization.


Financial Analysis, Procurement & Cost Visibility


Support procurement and purchasing activities by validating invoices and ensuring alignment to approved budgets and plans.
Monitor vineyard operating costs and spending trends to improve financial visibility across the organization.
Partner with Finance and operational teams to improve cost reporting and forecasting accuracy.
Identify potential productivity or cost-related risks before they become larger operational challenges.
Maintain disciplined documentation and reporting standards that support planning, budgeting, and operational decision-making.
Help establish stronger cost controls and spending transparency across vineyard operations.


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Partner closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, finance teams, vendors, and stakeholders across the business.
Build trusted relationships while introducing new ways of measuring and evaluating operational performance.
Support the development of data-driven processes that improve consistency and operational discipline across vineyard operations.
Bring curiosity, fresh thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset to help evolve how work gets done.
Contribute to a culture where decisions are informed by data, insight, and transparency.
Act as a bridge between operational teams and data, ensuring insights translate into meaningful action.


Who You Are


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
2+ years of experience in business analysis, operational analytics, financial analysis, supply chain, procurement, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced Excel skills with strong capabilities in data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to transform data into actionable recommendations.
Comfortable working with both operational and financial datasets in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data and insights.
Experience in agriculture, wine, food manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, or operational environments is considered an asset, but not required.
Naturally curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by solving problems and improving processes.
Able to translate complex information into simple, practical business recommendations.


What's In It For You


A rare opportunity to help build and shape how vineyard performance is measured across one of Canada's most respected premium wine organizations.
Visible impact across vineyard operations, influencing planning, budgeting, productivity improvement, and operational decision-making.
Exposure to vineyard operations, finance, procurement, business analytics, and strategic planning in one highly collaborative role.
The opportunity to create reporting tools and processes that become foundational to how our teams operate.
A role where your insights directly influence business decisions rather than sit in a report.
Partnership with experienced vineyard, finance, and operational leaders who value curiosity, fresh thinking, and continuous improvement.
The ability to bring a fresh lens, challenge legacy processes, and make a measurable impact on how the business operates.
Opportunity to grow your scope and influence as our vineyard analytics and reporting capabilities continue to evolve.


Why Join Us?

Iconic Wineries of British Columbia is committed to hiring, engaging, and growing qualified, talented, and motivated team members at every level of our organization. We offer competitive compensation that recognizes individual and company performance. The typical hiring range for this position is $65,000 - $80,000 annually, complemented by a bonus plan. Base pay is determined by market location and job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and education.

As part of our Total Rewards program, we are also proud to offer:


Access to company-matched RRSP contributions
Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans with 24/7 access to care and support for you and your family
Paid time off
Training and development to build a fulfilling career


At Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, We Exist to Unearth the Extraordinary

Best in Our Craft

We set the standard with a pursuit of excellence that can be found in everything from our products and processes to our vineyards and people.

Ambitiously Curious

We stay curious, dreaming big and navigating the unknown with an enduring belief in better.

Made With Humility

We bring humility, authenticity, fun, and support to every collaboration and celebrate wins as a team.

Daringly Disruptive

We disrupt the status quo, moving fast to seize opportunities and acting scrappy to stay ahead of industry giants.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Hi, we're HUB!

We are a leading North American insurance brokerage that advises businesses and individuals on how to reach their goals. When you partner with us, you're at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you're ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity!

This is a permanent, full-time position, reporting to the Director, Business Intelligence at HUB Canada West (HCW).

As the Data Scientist, you are the technical engine of a small, high-leverage analytics function. This role exists to turn HCW's growing data foundation across cloud data platforms and SQL into measurable business value: predictive models, self-serve analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered tools that change how branches and leadership make decisions.

The successful candidate brings classical data science fundamentals (statistics, machine learning, experimental design) and is equally comfortable in the emerging world of AI engineering: prompting and orchestrating large language models, building reusable AI workflows, and integrating LLMs into BI products. As the discipline of data science continues to converge with AI engineering, we want someone who can move fluidly across both.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor and a generalist problem solver. You enjoy ambiguity, you pick up new tools quickly, and you care about outcomes more than orthodoxy.

What You'll Bring To Our Team -


5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics engineering, advanced analytics, or a directly related applied technical role.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar). Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal credentials.
Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is a strong asset, with practical familiarity with concepts such as policies in force, premium, retention, and producer compensation.
A generalist, problem-solving mindset: comfortable picking up new tools, languages, and platforms; energized by ambiguity rather than blocked by it.


Skills & Competencies

Must-Haves


Strong SQL skills, including comfort with complex joins, and query optimization against large datasets.
Strong Python skills for analysis, modelling, and automation (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), plus practical experience with ML Algorithms such as Random Forest, Recommender Systems or Clustering.
Demonstrated production experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and the ability to design dashboards that leadership can intuitively use.
Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, and model evaluation; able to choose the right tool for the question rather than reaching for the most complex one.
Demonstrated ability to use Claude (or other AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent) as a serious working tool: structured prompting, iterative refinement, awareness of failure modes, guardrails, and the discipline to verify outputs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical findings into business decisions and to write clearly for executive audiences.


Nice-to-Haves


Experience building Claude Skills, artifacts, MCP server integrations, or agentic AI workflows.
General familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, is a plus as HCW's data environment evolves.
Experience with light data engineering tooling such as dbt, Airflow, or Cloud Composer.
Comfort with version control (Git), code review practices, and collaborative development workflows.
Familiarity with Canadian data privacy requirements (PIPEDA) and the practical realities of working with sensitive customer and HR data.


A Day in the Life -

Analytics And Modelling


Design and deliver applied analytics and machine learning solutions across sales, retention, finance, operations, and talent (for example, customer segmentation, churn and renewal probability, book of business analytics, producer performance modelling).
Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into structured analytical problems, choose the right level of methodological rigour for the decision at hand, and communicate results in plain language.
Apply solid statistical thinking to model evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and the honest framing of data quality limitations.


AI Engineering


Build and maintain production-grade prompts, Claude Skills, and AI-assisted workflows that extend HCW's analytical reach (for example, manager-facing prompt playbooks for self-serve call analytics).
Integrate large language models with HCW data sources to enable natural-language analytics, automated narrative generation, and intelligent document processing.
Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and bring promising techniques into HCW thoughtfully, with appropriate guardrails.


Data Access And Transformation


Extract, join, and transform data from HCW's data warehouse, Power BI semantic layer, and other source systems to support analytical work. Note: this is not a heavy data engineering role. Platform, ingestion, and core pipeline work sits primarily with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT. The Data Scientist is expected to access and shape data, not to build the warehouse.
Engineer features, build reproducible analytical pipelines, and document data lineage and assumptions.


Business Intelligence And Self-Serve


Build interactive Power BI dashboards that make analytical output usable by branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives.
Develop reusable Power BI templates and data structures that let branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives self-serve their own analysis without relying on ad hoc analyst support.
Track adoption of Power BI reports and dashboards, and surface how they are being used to drive measurable business value across branches and leadership.


Automation


Identify high-friction manual reporting and operational workflows, then automate them using Python, scheduled data pipeline jobs, Power Automate, or AI-powered workflows.
Design automation that is observable, recoverable, and trusted by the business.


Stakeholder Engagement And Communication


Work directly with the COO, regional leadership, and operational managers to scope work and present findings.
Coach and uplift the broader BI community of practice on Python, SQL, AI tooling, and analytical thinking.
Collaborate with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT on data standards, governance, and shared platform decisions.


Salary Expectations -

The expected salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate's skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position's business line, scope, and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include extended health benefits, disability insurance, RRSP matching, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses. If you believe that your qualifications and experience surpass the minimum requirements for this role, we encourage you to submit your application. By doing so, we will be able to keep your application on file for consideration for potential future positions within our organization.

Why Join HUB?


Do you enjoy making friends? We love making friends; join our team of amazing people who all get along and thrive together!
We work hard and play hard! Get ready for our Staff Holiday Parties!!
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!
Paid day off for volunteering in your community – HUB is a company that gives back and is active in our communities.
Room to grow within the organization.
Lots of company perks, benefits, RRSP matching and great compensation.


Your Future with HUB -

Choose a career with HUB International and take the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction. By joining HUB, you will become part of a rapidly growing company that offers significant opportunity for advancement.

At HUB, we value education and continuous learning, and we will assist you along your career development path. We provide HUB Ready training for new employees, as well as financial support for licensing, industry designations, management & leadership development, and other related courses, designations or programs.

What makes us different than all the rest?

Our Vision: To be everywhere risk exists – today and tomorrow. Helping protect what matters most.

Our Mission: To protect and support the aspirations of individuals, families and businesses. To empower our employees to learn, grow and make a difference in their communities.

Our Core Values


Entrepreneurship: We encourage innovation and educated risk-taking.
Integrity: We do the right thing every time.
Teamwork: We work together to maximize results.
Accountability: We measure and take responsibility for outcomes.
Service: We serve customers, communities and colleagues.


If you value what we value, and like the perks along the way – Apply TODAY!

HUB is a company where your contributions will make a difference. We invite you to learn more about our team at www.hubinternational.com. Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount


We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

Title: Systems Analyst, Enterprise Applications & Reporting
Description:
Overview 




Silver Creek Software Ltd. is an Alberta-based consulting firm specializing in data management, analytics, application development, automation, and modern workplace solutions. We partner with public sector and enterprise clients to deliver complex, high-impact technology initiatives. Our team is known for its professionalism, technical depth, and commitment to excellence. We maintain a high standard of hiring and are proud to work alongside driven, capable professionals. 




We are seeking a Systems Analyst to support data analysis, reporting, and enterprise application maintenance initiatives across a variety of client environments. This is a hands-on technical role suited to a professional who is comfortable working with SQL and relational databases, while being capable of developing broader skill across business intelligence and systems analysis. 




The successful candidate will work with established reporting, database, and enterprise application environments while progressively taking on responsibility for developing and modifying queries, developing dashboards, troubleshooting data and application issues, maintaining technical documentation, and supporting the ongoing operation and improvement of client systems. The role offers exposure to multiple technologies and business environments with the opportunity to contribute as a versatile data and technology consultant. 




This opportunity is suitable for both full-time employment or contract arrangements. 




Key Responsibilities 




Execute, review, troubleshoot, and modify SQL queries to support recurring reporting, data analysis, validation, system investigation, and ad hoc business requests. 
Work with relational databases and operational datasets to investigate data issues, verify results, and maintain accurate reporting and system outputs. 
Support the ongoing operation and maintenance of enterprise applications, databases, and data-management platforms. 
Investigate application, database, reporting, access, configuration, and data issues and work with technical team members to identify and implement appropriate resolutions. 
Assist with user provisioning, permissions, configuration, and other routine application-support activities. 
Monitor application and system processes and assist with identifying workload, performance, data-processing, or operational issues. 
Develop, enhance, and support Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations, filters, and interactive reporting functionality. 
Assist with the maintenance and improvement of reporting databases, datasets, data models, and related reporting processes. 
Create and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, metadata, query documentation, process documentation, and system-support materials. 
Gather and clarify reporting, data, and system requirements from business and technical stakeholders and translate them into practical technical solutions. 
Develop or maintain lightweight scripts and automation using tools such as Python, PowerShell, VBA, or Power Automate where appropriate. 
Maintain scripts, queries, documentation, configuration files, and other technical assets using source control and collaborative development tools. 
Test and validate reporting, dashboard, query, application, and system changes before deployment or release. 
Support data, code, documentation, or source-control migration activities where required. 
Participate in scheduled production-support or on-call activities where required. 
Contribute to multiple client engagements and adapt to different technology environments, business processes, systems, and project requirements. 




Qualifications 




Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Computer Software Development, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related technical discipline. 
1-3 years of hands-on professional experience in data analysis, database support, systems analysis, application support, business intelligence, or a related technical role. 
Hands-on experience supporting a production application, database environment, enterprise data platform, or comparable business-critical technology system. 
Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts. 
Ability to understand, execute, troubleshoot, and modify existing SQL queries. 
Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or another enterprise relational database platform. 
Experience or applied knowledge of Power BI or another business intelligence and reporting platform. 
Ability to systematically investigate data, application, and system issues using available logs, queries, documentation, system information, and other technical resources. 
Ability to learn and support unfamiliar or specialized applications and technologies. 
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with careful attention to data accuracy and detail. 
Ability to understand technical documentation and independently investigate unfamiliar technical problems. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively within collaborative consulting and project teams.

Job Description

We are seeking a customer‑focused Data Analyst to join our Corporate Human Resources team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on turning data into actionable insights, enjoys engaging with stakeholders, and is passionate about empowering others to advance their analytics capabilities. You will contribute to building our enterprise data foundation—including the development of our data lake, secure data access, and advanced reporting—and support analytics across the HR function. The role also involves applying AI technologies and building analytical agents to automate insights and enhance decision‑making. The salary range for this position is between $60,000 - $85,500 annually.

Responsibilities


Partner with business and leaders to understand operational challenges and develop data‑driven solutions that support strategic decision‑making.
Act as a trusted advisor, educating internal customers on analytics tools, data literacy, and best practices for self‑service and data‑informed thinking.
Support the development and evolution of the enterprise data lake, including defining requirements, validating datasets, and enabling downstream analytics.
Manage user security and access controls to maintain governed, appropriate data access.
Deliver analytics and reporting across Human Resources, providing visibility into performance, risks, and trends.
Build and deploy AI‑powered analytics capabilities, including agents that automate data processing, summarize insights, and augment reporting workflows.
Lead requirements‑gathering sessions and translate business needs into effective reporting and visualization solutions.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI and Alteryx.
Analyze complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that influence business decisions and initiative selection.
Identify opportunities to automate, optimize, and standardize data and analytics processes.
Support data governance practices including data quality, integrity, metadata standards, and stewardship.
Mentor colleagues on interpreting data, leveraging analytics, and applying emerging AI tools effectively.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in analytics, data management, or business analysis.
Experience applying AI in a business context, including building or deploying AI agents.
Experience working with data lakes, data pipelines, or enterprise data platforms is an asset.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
Proficiency in Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, and Excel.
Ability to explain complex analytical and AI concepts in clear, engaging ways for non‑technical audiences.
Strong problem‑solving abilities and a creative, innovative approach to analytics.
Background in statistics, Lean, or Six Sigma is an asset.

Description:
The Opportunity

Are you someone who loves uncovering insights hidden in data? We’re looking for an Analyst, Business Analysis to join our Finance team within Insurance Services. In this role, you’ll collaborate with teams across AMA to turn complex information into meaningful insights that help guide sound business decisions. You’ll analyze trends, process and products, and bring clarity to big questions — all while helping us make smarter, data-driven choices that serve our members better. In this role, you will also be supporting the corporate reserving function, to support informed business decisions across pricing, underwriting, reinsurance, and capital management.

A Place to Belong

AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!

About

Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy:


Competitive salary and flexible benefits
Employer-paid retirement savings program
Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, and more
Free travel medical insurance for you and your immediate family
Ongoing professional development
Paid vacation and personal days, including a Volunteer Day and Me Day
Flexible work models that make sense for your lifestyle


Who You Are


A curious, analytical thinker who loves solving complex problems with data.
A strong communicator who can translate numbers into meaningful business stories.
Naturally collaborative — you enjoy working across teams to find solutions that make an impact.
Detail-oriented, organized, and confident managing multiple priorities.
You thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where innovation and teamwork drive results.


How You’ll Make An Impact


Provide data-driven support to guide action-oriented business decisions across AMA.
Analyze and interpret data from multiple sources to identify key trends and opportunities.
Develop and manage high-quality dashboards and reporting solutions that serve as a single source of truth.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and IT teams to gather, validate, and refine business requirements.
Present findings and insights to leadership teams in clear, compelling ways.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of critical data.
Support the rollout of new business analytics tools and processes.


What You Bring To The Table


Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in actuarial analysis, business intelligence, business analysis, or a related technical role.
Advanced working knowledge of SQL (including complex query writing).
Experience developing and managing BI solutions or dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
Strong data visualization and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
Familiarity with data management languages (Python, R) and experience in the insurance industry are strong assets.
Experience in the insurance industry is preferred.
Actuarial reserving experience would be an asset.


Belonging Matters Here

AMA is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation at any time during our recruitment process, please contact recruitment@ama.ab.ca. We’ll work with you to ensure you feel supported throughout your journey with us.

As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce.

Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment

You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required

Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.




How we’ll make you feel at Home

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:

  • Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
  • Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
  • Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
  • Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
  • Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
  • Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
  • Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.

You Have:

  • 3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
  • Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
  • Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
  • Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
  • Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
  • Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.

Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

  • RRSP plan with company match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Life Insurance & Disability
  • Continuing education and travel benefits

Title: Data Analyst Engineer
Description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic Data & Analytics team, within the Platforms & Transformation group. The Data Engineer will use their technical, analytical and insurance expertise while working as part of project teams to deliver the benefits to AXIS. This is an excellent opportunity to work within great teams across the business on complex, challenging and rewarding projects and initiatives to build towards the success of AXIS.

What will you do in this role?

Data Analysis & Modelling:


Work with the business teams, including senior leaders, to define the data products and use cases along with their data lineage, critical data elements, data glossaries and data quality rules.
Work with the Data Architecture team to enable the design of best-in-class current state and future state data flow diagrams
Partner with the Data Insights and AI & Innovation teams to design the outputs and workflows for Use Cases and Data Products.
Use your industry experience to define the metrics required for projects and solutions.
Lead the QA testing of data products and supporting the business teams during UAT.
Support the future phases of data products you have delivered in projects once live where you are considered a subject matter expert and have a relationship with the business teams.



Data Engineering:


Run simple and complex queries to understand existing data structures and relationships, data quality gaps and metric formulas to enable accurate documentation of the current state solutions.
Use your advanced Excel skills to reverse engineer complex workbooks with macros and layered formulas to enable modular redesign in our modern data architecture.
Build and execute test models against both on-premises SQL Server and Azure Databricks databases.
Work closely with the development teams to ensure your data product templates are clearly defined to the specifications required by the application delivery leads.
You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.



About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience).
4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused role.
Very strong SQL and Excel experience
Design experience with star schemas and delta concepts
Experience in data modelling in Excel having worked within Data Governance and Data Quality frameworks
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to understanding data quality issues and challenges
Experience with large complex projects delivering data products and use cases
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to time manage and work across different priorities.



What we prefer you to have:


Insurance industry experience.
Microsoft SQL Server and Azure Databricks experience
Ability to read programming languages
Knowledge of Insurance KPIs and metrics and processing within Underwriting, Claims and Pricing
Experience taking a key role on Data & Analytics projects



Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

This position is a hybrid role and will require mandatory in office presence 3 days per week.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $75,000 - $120,000 CAD (Nova Scotia). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
