Title: Systems Analyst, Enterprise Applications & Reporting
Description:
Overview 




Silver Creek Software Ltd. is an Alberta-based consulting firm specializing in data management, analytics, application development, automation, and modern workplace solutions. We partner with public sector and enterprise clients to deliver complex, high-impact technology initiatives. Our team is known for its professionalism, technical depth, and commitment to excellence. We maintain a high standard of hiring and are proud to work alongside driven, capable professionals. 




We are seeking a Systems Analyst to support data analysis, reporting, and enterprise application maintenance initiatives across a variety of client environments. This is a hands-on technical role suited to a professional who is comfortable working with SQL and relational databases, while being capable of developing broader skill across business intelligence and systems analysis. 




The successful candidate will work with established reporting, database, and enterprise application environments while progressively taking on responsibility for developing and modifying queries, developing dashboards, troubleshooting data and application issues, maintaining technical documentation, and supporting the ongoing operation and improvement of client systems. The role offers exposure to multiple technologies and business environments with the opportunity to contribute as a versatile data and technology consultant. 




This opportunity is suitable for both full-time employment or contract arrangements. 




Key Responsibilities 




Execute, review, troubleshoot, and modify SQL queries to support recurring reporting, data analysis, validation, system investigation, and ad hoc business requests. 
Work with relational databases and operational datasets to investigate data issues, verify results, and maintain accurate reporting and system outputs. 
Support the ongoing operation and maintenance of enterprise applications, databases, and data-management platforms. 
Investigate application, database, reporting, access, configuration, and data issues and work with technical team members to identify and implement appropriate resolutions. 
Assist with user provisioning, permissions, configuration, and other routine application-support activities. 
Monitor application and system processes and assist with identifying workload, performance, data-processing, or operational issues. 
Develop, enhance, and support Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations, filters, and interactive reporting functionality. 
Assist with the maintenance and improvement of reporting databases, datasets, data models, and related reporting processes. 
Create and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, metadata, query documentation, process documentation, and system-support materials. 
Gather and clarify reporting, data, and system requirements from business and technical stakeholders and translate them into practical technical solutions. 
Develop or maintain lightweight scripts and automation using tools such as Python, PowerShell, VBA, or Power Automate where appropriate. 
Maintain scripts, queries, documentation, configuration files, and other technical assets using source control and collaborative development tools. 
Test and validate reporting, dashboard, query, application, and system changes before deployment or release. 
Support data, code, documentation, or source-control migration activities where required. 
Participate in scheduled production-support or on-call activities where required. 
Contribute to multiple client engagements and adapt to different technology environments, business processes, systems, and project requirements. 




Qualifications 




Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Computer Software Development, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related technical discipline. 
1-3 years of hands-on professional experience in data analysis, database support, systems analysis, application support, business intelligence, or a related technical role. 
Hands-on experience supporting a production application, database environment, enterprise data platform, or comparable business-critical technology system. 
Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts. 
Ability to understand, execute, troubleshoot, and modify existing SQL queries. 
Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or another enterprise relational database platform. 
Experience or applied knowledge of Power BI or another business intelligence and reporting platform. 
Ability to systematically investigate data, application, and system issues using available logs, queries, documentation, system information, and other technical resources. 
Ability to learn and support unfamiliar or specialized applications and technologies. 
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with careful attention to data accuracy and detail. 
Ability to understand technical documentation and independently investigate unfamiliar technical problems. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively within collaborative consulting and project teams. 




Desirable Attributes 




Experience developing Power BI dashboards, data models, measures, or interactive reports. 
Experience with SSRS, Microsoft Report Builder, or similar reporting technologies. 
Experience supporting enterprise data-management, monitoring, operational, or time-series systems. 
Experience working with time-series, environmental monitoring, geospatial, sensor, operational, or other complex datasets. 
Experience with Oracle databases and SQL Server environments. 
Exposure to Python, PowerShell, Power Automate, VBA, or other scripting and automation tools. 
Experience with GitHub, Git, Azure DevOps, TFS, JIRA, or similar development and work-management platforms. 
Familiarity with data dictionaries, metadata management, data quality, or technical documentation. 
Experience with user provisioning, access management, application configuration, system monitoring, or production support. 
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, C#, .NET, JavaScript, or other application-development technologies. 
Experience supporting data imports, data transformations, integrations, scheduled processes, or other automated data workflows. 
Interest in using modern AI-assisted development and analytics tools responsibly to accelerate technical work and learning. 
Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar technologies independently and apply new knowledge to practical problems. 




Join Us 




Silver Creek offers the opportunity to work with a high-performing team on meaningful projects that deliver real value to our clients. We provide flexibility, autonomy, and trust, while holding ourselves to a high standard of professionalism and accountability.

Strong experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualization tools (Power BI) with demonstrated experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write complex and efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate and transform data from multiple sources and automate data pipelines
Advanced skills in Power BI, Data Modeling, Power Query, and DAX
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL‑300) certification preferred
Strong experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Subject matter expertise in data analytics and statistical modelling
Polished communication and presentation skills to audiences including senior leadership
Strong analytical skills for problem solving and to monetize value for the organization
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instruction
Think outside the box and identify solutions to overcome obstacles
Proven ability to learn and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset

POSITION TITLE: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist

DEPARTMENT: Finance, Administration & Information Technology

CLASSIFICATION: MGO-07

SALARY RANGE: Starting at $79,591.00 Per Annum

POSITION TYPE: Full-time, Permanent

LOCATION: Saskatoon

ACCOUNTABLE TO : Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT

Brief Overview

The Financial Database & Analytics Specialist is responsible for the profiling, development, integration, and optimization of enterprise databases and reporting solutions that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, performance measurement, and operational analysis. This position serves as the government's technical specialist in database profiling, data availability, systems integration, business intelligence, and analytical reporting, helping transform data from multiple systems into reliable information for decision-making across government.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Compliance, Governance & Risk Management


Profiles, develop, maintains, and optimizes enterprise databases, data models, and reporting structures that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, operational analysis, and performance measurement.
Supports the integration of data across finance, payroll, human resource, procurement, project management, funding agreement, and other government systems.


Financial Analysis & Decision Support


Provides technical and analytical support for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, funding agreement reporting, trend analysis, key performance indicators, and executive reporting.
Works closely with Finance to ensure reliable information is available to support financial planning, resource allocation, reporting obligations, and decision-making.


Enterprise Reporting & Business Intelligence


Develops and maintains reports, dashboards, data extracts, automated reporting solutions, and analytical models that support government-wide reporting requirements.
Translate business requirements into practical database structures, queries, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that improve accessibility and use of information while maintaining data security, privacy protection standards.


Data Quality, Automation & Continuous Improvement


Improves the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and accessibility of enterprise data used for financial and operational reporting.
Identifies opportunities to streamline reporting processes, automate recurring reporting requirements, reduce manual effort, and improve the efficiency of data collection and analysis activities across government.


Technical Documentation, Collaboration & Advisory Support


Develops and maintains technical documentation related to databases, data models, data flows, and system integrations.
Works collaboratively with ministries, departments, program areas, internal consulting teams, external consulting teams, Information Technology, and system vendors to assess data availability, recommend appropriate data structures and classifications, and support reporting and analytical requirements.
Other duties as assigned by the Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong proficiency in SQL, data extraction, transformation, and reporting development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the ability to translate reporting requirements into technical solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power Query, and financial data analysis tools.
Ability to assess data availability, relationships, and appropriate categorization across multiple systems.
Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, performance measurement, and government reporting environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years progressive financial analysis, database development or relevant experience.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SSRS, or equivalent.
An equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and progressively responsible experience may be considered


Additional Requirements


Must undergo a Criminal Record Check
Valid Saskatchewan driver’s license and access reliable transportation
Please submit your application by 9:59 PM on August 27, 2026.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Business Analyst

Eastlink




Work Location: 33 Alderney Drive, Dartmouth, NS (On-site, 5 days per week)

Department: Customer Care

Reports To: Director, Customer Service & Accounts Receivable

Employment Status: Full time, 40 hours per week




At Eastlink, our Business Analysts are driven by curiosity, problem-solving, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. By transforming data into actionable insights, they help us improve performance and enhance the customer experience to move the business forward.

In this role, you'll support our Customer Care and Accounts Receivable teams by providing analysis that helps leaders understand performance and anticipate future business needs. You'll work across teams to evaluate trends, support planning activities, and recommend improvements that contribute to operational effectiveness and business success.




What You’ll Be Doing

As a Business Analyst, you'll help the business better understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions. You will:

Monitor and analyze key operational, customer service, and Accounts Receivable metrics.
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance scorecards.
Present findings in a clear way to help teams prioritize actions and achieve results.
Support forecasting, workforce planning, and sales performance tracking.
Partner with leaders to evaluate challenges, answer business questions, and recommend solutions.
Contribute to improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and support business goals.




What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with information, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions. You’ll succeed in this role if you:

Are naturally curious and enjoy understanding the story behind the numbers.
Take ownership of your work and can confidently manage priorities independently.
Approach challenges with strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
Can identify trends, evaluate impacts, and make well-supported recommendations.
Are comfortable working with both detailed information and the bigger business picture.
Build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively with different teams.
Communicate clearly and can adjust information to different audiences.
Have a strong commitment to accuracy, quality, and continuous learning.




What You’ll Bring

Three or more years of experience in an analytical, financial, operational, or business support role.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with large and complex datasets.
Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, and interpreting business data.







Strong reporting and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate findings effectively.
Experience working with performance metrics, forecasting, and operational reporting.
Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management abilities.
Experience with business intelligence, analytics, or data visualization tools.
A results-oriented mindset and a desire to contribute to team and organizational success.
Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Analytics, or a related field, is considered an asset.
Experience in a customer service, collections, call centre, or telecommunications environment is considered an asset.

Eastlink is proudly family-owned and headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia. After more than 50 years, we’ve grown from a small-town startup into one of Canada’s Best Managed companies without losing our entrepreneurial edge. We move fast. We try new things. We care about doing right by our customers, and we’re not afraid to take a different approach to make that happen.




Why Work with Us

We could say we’re not your typical telecom, but what makes us different is how we operate day to day. At Eastlink, we’re a tight-knit team all working toward common goals. We’re big enough to do meaningful work, but small enough that you can actually make your mark. You won’t get stuck waiting for layers of approval or years of tenure to make an impact! We believe in getting involved, speaking up, and figuring things out together. We’re always listening, learning, and adapting because our customers (and our people) expect us to. And just like we invest in our network, we invest in you, with intention and for the long run.




When you join Eastlink, you'll enjoy:

Opportunities for internal growth and promotion

Comprehensive health and dental benefits
Company pension plan with employer contributions
Employee discounts on Eastlink products and services

Support business intelligence, reporting automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

Participate in special projects and ad hoc analytical initiatives requiring a strong mix of technical skill, business judgment, and communication.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field.

Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a visible role with accountability to senior stakeholders.
Polished, professional, and credible communicator with a strong business partnering mindset.

Hybrid work environment.

Blend of technical analytics, reporting, and stakeholder-facing business support.
Strong long-term career growth opportunity within a well-established Canadian organization.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We're a group of go-getters who decided they didn't want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer


An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.
The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.
Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.


What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can not only deliver insights, dashboards, and analysis but also help connect the data behind them. This role blends analytics with light analytics engineering, ensuring the data our teams rely on is accurate, well-structured, and accessible. You'll work across marketplace, advertising, and revenue platforms to understand user behavior, performance trends, and product outcomes. You'll also help coordinate the flow of data from source platforms into our data warehouse and reporting tools so insights are consistent and trustworthy.


Analyze user behavior to identify interests, predict actions, and map the path to purchase for RVs, motorcycles, boats, and commercial equipment.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau and Power BI to enable self-serve insights for sales teams.
Work on sales attribution by combining cross-category sales data with on-site user shopping behavior to support the value of our partnerships.
Leverage multiple data sources to create innovative visualizations that better depict user engagement and the customer journey.
Help scope and coordinate data integrations from platforms into Snowflake and BI tools.
Work with engineering to support ELT pipeline requirements, define logic, validate incoming data, and ensure successful delivery.
Transform raw data into reporting-ready models (joins, mapping, standardization, QA) using SQL in our data warehouse.
Provide actionable recommendations to improve customer engagement and product performance throughout the purchase journey.
Develop proactive monitoring and alerting systems to identify and respond to anomalies in performance metrics such as eCPM, CTR, RPM, and viewability.
Analyze programmatic data, including bid streams and pricing models, to identify revenue optimization opportunities.
Partner with Ad Ops and Finance to reconcile delivery, billing, and performance data across platforms for reporting accuracy and client satisfaction.


What We're Looking For


4+ years of experience in data analysis, ideally within digital media, ad tech, marketplace, or ecommerce environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Pyramid, Looker Studio, etc.) and strong SQL skills.
Experience analyzing user behavior, conversion funnels, and performance metrics across multiple platforms.
Experience working with data pipelines or integrations, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional technical projects.
Familiarity with ELT concepts, data modeling, or analytics engineering tasks.
Strong data storytelling skills. The ability to break down complex findings into clear, compelling recommendations.


Bonus Points


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Basic coding skills in Python, R, or a similar language to support data preparation and advanced analysis.


The expected salary range for this role is $79,000 - $90,000 CAD

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




The Data & Analytics team within the IT Solutions line of business has an ambitious mandate, where we are accountable for leveraging Data & Analytics to deliver business value both internally as well as to external clients through the following:




Enhance existing or create new products and services with proprietary data assets and partnering with external data providers, through the application of data science
Design and deliver cutting-edge reporting solutions to bring data to life
Conduct advanced data analysis to generate business insights that drive strategic decision-making
Demonstrate thought leadership in the ecosystem in which we operate
Provide actionable recommendations to improve overall organizational efficiencies




In addition, this team will play an important role in evangelizing and educating the value of Data & Analytics to the rest of the organization, in support of cultivating a data-driven culture.

You will support these ambitious goals primarily through ensuring seamless data integration, maintaining high quality data standards, collaborating with cross functional teams, and delivering comprehensive analyses and innovative visualization using business intelligence tools.




What You’ll Be Doing







The Senior Data Analyst plays a pivotal role in driving data-informed decisions across our organization. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and data expertise, this hands-on role brings clarity to complex problems and empowers teams with actionable insights:




Business Data Consultation (35%)

Collaborate across marketing, product, finance, partner solutions, data engineering and other teams to deeply understand business objectives
Translate business questions into technical data needs, ensuring alignment with project goals
Research, identify and then collect / extract the external data sets required for the use case. Creativity, thinking outside of the box, and resourcefulness is required to find new and relevant data sources to meet business requirements
Exhibit strong attention to detail while working with large datasets to ensure accuracy, completeness and high-quality standards
Translate technical findings into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business use cases




Data Processing and Engineering Support (30%)

Partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to ensure data pipelines and models align with organizational goal
Diagnose and enhance data quality across diverse sources
Recommend ways to integrate disparate data sources into a usable data model to meet business requirements
Present business insights in a meaningful and intuitive manner, in accordance with the target audience, using Tableau, Excel, and other BI tools




Data Analytics and Visualization (35%)

Implement segmentation and categorization techniques to build dynamic solutions tailored to use case
Demonstrate curiosity by exploring datasets, conducting exploratory data analysis to uncover hidden trends, outliers, anomalies, and identify insights that might not be obvious
Provide detailed analysis of customer behavior, market trends, and competitive landscape to support product, sales and marketing strategies
Build advanced dashboards and visualizations that turn data into compelling narratives







About You




What will you need to be successful?




You are someone who:




Is keen to understand the business – data analytics cannot be done in a vacuum – we need to be close to the business so that we understand what we are trying to solve for and what the data means.
Tells stories from data – data analytics is not data dump – it needs to be meaningful and intuitive to the end user to realize the inherent business value.
Challenges the status quo – the state of business and the field of data analytics are constantly evolving, and we need to as well.Assumptions and old ways of doing things are open season, as long as you bring along workable and relevant solutions articulated in a professional manner. Proactively pursue and learn about new data sets, analytical tools, and methodologies to solve problems in new and innovative ways.
Is good at problem solving – someone who can “connect the dots”, and have a logical and methodical way to tackle new and complex problems.
Takes pride in your work – your work is diligent and thorough and you are proud of your reputation for high-quality and reliable work.
Is a quick study – the successful candidate must be curious, resourceful, and dig into the weeds to ask the right questions and figure things out independently.
Is a good communicator – someone who is polished and can communicate effectively with internal and external parties to ensure alignment on data analysis and reporting needs.




Technical qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field: Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst
Proficiency in SQL, Python and Excel
Advanced expertise in Tableau, or other BI tools
Knowledge of Big Data Technologies (HDFS, Spark, etc.) and Cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
Understanding of spatial data concepts, including geospatial data formats (e.g., GeoJSON, Shapefiles), spatial analysis, and tools like ArcGIS




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $110,000 - $132,000 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.










At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Senior BI Specialist – End‑to‑end delivery specialists combining advanced Power BI development with strong data‑engineering capability, owning solutions from discovery through build, validation, and rollout
Senior Data Foundation Analyst – Data‑engineering–focused role responsible for building, enriching, and governing data pipelines and datasets that enable downstream BI and analytics


As a Senior Analyst you will join Canada Life’s Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. The Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics is a data subject matter expert enhancing decision making, monitoring business performance, providing actionable insight, and driving operational efficiencies using advanced analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will model, analyze, and predict complex business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will oversee and support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements; collect, integrate, clean, model, and analyze large datasets; and visualize and present insights to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Use Azure Databricks and advanced SQL to transform and model data, and Power BI to deliver governed, insight‑driven reporting and analytics solutions
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Apply strong communication, influence, and strategic thinking to shape analytics solutions and drive business decisions
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Oversee and support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Assist the business in the ideation of new analytics initiatives ranging from descriptive, diagnostic, predictive to prescriptive
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner
Retrieve, integrate, and transform data from multiple systems using SQL, Python, and other scripting languages

Ability to write complex and efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate and transform data from multiple sources and automate data pipelines
Advanced skills in Power BI, Data Modeling, Power Query, and DAX
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL‑300) certification preferred
Strong experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Subject matter expertise in data analytics and statistical modelling
Polished communication and presentation skills to audiences including senior leadership
Strong analytical skills for problem solving and to monetize value for the organization
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instruction
Think outside the box and identify solutions to overcome obstacles
Proven ability to learn and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset

Description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you!




The Role:




We are currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst to monitor, assess, and translate key business data into meaningful insights. This role will focus on Omnichannel core KPIs, sales and profit performance, marketing effectiveness, and site performance to help optimize results and support informed business decisions.

The incumbent will also lead eCommerce market intelligence activities, including online market sizing, brand-level market share analysis, competitive insights, global best-price benchmarking, and market price monitoring.




What you’re responsible for:




KPI Management (50%)

Track and manage sales and profit performance against targets and historical results.
Design, develop, and maintain KPIs for eCommerce and store performance.
Develop tracking tools for site operations and Omnichannel KPIs, including visits, conversion, bounce rate, average order value, attach rate, reserve and pick-up, and cart abandonment rate; analyze results and provide actionable insights.
Develop tracking tools for partner-related KPIs, including transaction processing, shipping lead time, fraud rejections, and return lead time; analyze results and identify opportunities for improvement.
Partner with the Marketing Manager to assess digital marketing campaign effectiveness and provide timely recommendations for updates or changes.
Manage and maintain the BI reporting tool developed in Tableau.
Use Omniture and Google Analytics to extract and analyze performance-related data.
Support the development of weekly, monthly, and annual revenue targets by SKU, aligned with the mid- to long-term eCommerce strategy.




Market Intelligence (30%)

Partner with the Market Intelligence team to gather total market and eCommerce data and develop accurate online market size estimates.
Collaborate with external vendors to monitor industry trends and market share.
Maintain tracking tools for market-related data and reporting.
Monitor competitor activity and provide clear, actionable competitive analysis.
Work with HQ and review external sources to identify and share eCommerce store best practices.
Monitor product pricing across retail channels and assess alignment to ensure pricing is managed appropriately.




Strategy, Planning and Reporting (20%)

Support the development of weekly, monthly, and annual sales targets by SKU for eCommerce and stores.
Support the development of mid- to long-term strategies for eCommerce and store growth.
Develop regular KPI reports for internal stakeholders, highlighting key trends, results, and insights.
Prepare ad hoc reports and analysis as required to support business needs.




To Join Our Team:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, or a related field, with relevant professional experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from senior executives to support teams, both within and outside the organization.
Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision while consistently meeting deadlines.
Strong analytical, organizational, and planning skills.
Ability to translate data and insights into clear, compelling storylines for reports and presentations.




Technical Skills

Required: High proficiency in SQL for querying complex relational databases.
Required: Expertise in data visualization and building automated dashboards using BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Required: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, modeling).
Strongly Preferred: Experience with a statistical programming language (Python or R) for data manipulation and analysis.
Required: Hands-on experience with web analytics platforms, particularly Google Analytics







Let's Talk Perks

While the salary for this role is $75K to $89K, with a yearly eligible 10% bonus, your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:




Generous time off: 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.

Step 3: The final step is an in-person interview with the hiring manager and extended team members.

Job Description:

The Growth and Performance Marketing team within Sun Life’s Client Experience Office (CXO) has embarked on a major transformation. As part of this transformation, we are continuously launching and testing new ideas, platforms, and solutions to generate new leads and identify opportunities for existing clients and group members.

As a senior data analyst on the Client Acquisition Analytics team, you will be part of a large analytics community and will be focused within the Growth and Performance Marketing business helping the team by, but not limited to, mining data for business insights, analyzing and interpreting trends using statistical tools and techniques, reporting on business performance, and triaging code and data-related issues.

You will be supporting several key initiatives that are tied to our vision of growing our client base, improving advisor lead conversion, supporting the Head Office lead Evolution program and Channel of Choice, monitoring of our key performance indicators and championing the Retail Leads Data Modernization.

To achieve this, we will be leveraging many systems across Sunlife, gathering requirements, engaging with subject matter experts, and creating reporting. All of this is to be able to tell the story of our clients’ journeys and gather insights to improve their experience.

What will you do?


Work closely with business partners to identify complex business problems to solve and provide data driven solutions.
Analytic work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations in order to solve business problems.
Work with stakeholders across Sun Life as a subject matter expert in the prospect, client, and advisor data
Ongoing support to uncover opportunities that will drive incremental sales.
Develop metrics and KPIs to measure the performance of analytical and data products in the overall portfolio.
Provide support for annual business plan, monthly sales forecast, and insight analysis.
Operationalize reporting processes and synthesize key metrics into impactful and insightful dashboards to monitor and assess the success of the business initiatives/performance.
Perform reporting automation, self-serve analytics enablement, and promote the culture of analytics-driven decision making.


What you need to succeed:


5 + years experience working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating, and analyzing data, hypothesis testing, data modelling and data visualization)
5 + years experience with SQL, PySpark and other programming languages. Comfortable writing accurate, efficient, but complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources.
2+ years of experience with AWS Cloud Services (e.g. Glue, S3, Athena, Quick Suite)
2+ years of experience working with Tableau or other visualization tools
Experience using oral and written storytelling to share data driven insights in a clear, succinct manner.
Strong partnering approach with a commitment to meeting business partners' unique needs and expectations.
In-depth prioritization, planning, and change management skills to stay within time/scope of a task in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable learning new applications and processes quickly with minimal direction
Ability to document work.


What will be nice to have?


Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, forecasting etc.)
Experience in Salesforce
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Additional statistical programming languages (i.e SAS/R)
Advanced user of MS Excel and MS Access


Preferred Skills:


Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles, with strong attention to detail.
Understanding business. We have got a lot of data, and you need to turn it into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.
A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

We’re honoured to be recognized as a 2026 Best Workplaces in Canada by Great Place to Work® Canada.
We are thrilled to be recognized by Excellence Canada with their top-level certification, the Canada Order of Excellence for Mental Health at Work®, for prioritizing employee well-being, fostering a positive work culture, and achieving excellence in mental health.
Wellness programs that support the three pillars of your health – mental, physical, and financial
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential.
As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client need to choose where you work, at home or in the office

In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time.

Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

Konrad is a next-generation digital consultancy. We are dedicated to solving complex business problems for our global clients with creative and forward-thinking solutions. As a Senior Data Analyst, you are an experienced analytics professional who leads analytical initiatives and partners directly with stakeholders to shape data-informed strategy. You drive the design and delivery of analytics and reporting solutions that enable clients to understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident business decisions.

You work closely with consultants, data engineers, developers, designers and clients across multiple engagements. You own analytical problem-solving from discovery to delivery, mentor junior analysts, and help establish best practices across data modeling, experimentation, and reporting.

Lead analytical projects end-to-end including discovery, data validation, analysis, and presentation of recommendations

Perform deep-dive analyses to identify drivers, opportunities, and risks across product and business performance
Design and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation strategies, including statistical interpretation and recommendations
Collaborate with data engineers to design data models and ensure reliable, high-quality reporting layers
Mentor junior analysts and review analytical work to ensure quality and rigor
Communicate insights through clear narratives, visualizations, and executive-level presentations
Identify and implement improvements to analytics workflows, governance, and data quality processes

Strong SQL expertise and experience querying cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery)
Proficiency in Python, R, or similar language for data analysis and automation
Advanced experience with Business Intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Strong understanding of data modeling, dimensional modeling, and analytics architecture concepts
Experience defining KPIs, measurement frameworks, and decision metrics
Hands-on experience designing and analyzing experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, statistical interpretation)
Proven ability to independently structure ambiguous problems and deliver actionable insights
Experience working directly with stakeholders and presenting to leadership audiences

Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and security best practices

Culture of Learning & Development

This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion

Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

WHY WORK WITH US?


Make a difference by supporting and collaborating with a vibrant and creative community
Enjoy many options for workplace flexibility and work-life balance
Get involved in the rapidly changing creative space
Advocate for and empower the creative community
Together, we’ll help music creators earn more income and make a living


What We Offer


35-hour workweek schedule (possible flexible work options i.e., 4-day work week (position based)
Twelve paid sick days annually (including five personal days)
Access to SOCAN fitness facility
Annual Performance Incentive bonus (dependent on a personal and company performance)
Defined contribution Pension Plan
Comprehensive, health and dental benefits program
Inclusive and collaborative working environment 


About The Role

SOCAN is seeking a Data Analyst to join our Analytics department. In this role, you’ll be accountable for turning raw data into actionable business insights through various reports and dashboards, driving improvement in our key organizational initiatives. You must be comfortable working closely with data engineers, BI analysts, and business leaders. The ideal candidate has a solid grasp of data fundamentals and is eager, curious, and possesses a drive for continuous learning and self-improvement, especially with modern cloud data stacks.

The knowledge of English is required for this position as the position requires to interact on a constant and regular basis with English-speaking stakeholders outside of Quebec

What You’ll Do / Key Responsibilities


Work directly with data engineers, BI analysts, other data analysts, and business leaders to document reporting requirements and understand business processes and how they affect data.
Perform exploratory data analysis to clean, transform, and analyze large datasets within Databricks to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve our data.
Support data quality assurance by creating data quality tests and plans for various reporting and Lakehouse projects that can assist in troubleshooting data discrepancies and pipeline issues.
Work with each department leader to define and document KPIs.
Perform root-cause analysis on KPI fluctuations to provide actionable insights to department leaders.
Collaborate on the continuous development of interactive Databricks AI/BI dashboards and reports, designing and maintaining clear dashboards to communicate findings to various stakeholders.
Curate and document semantic layers to power natural language querying (Genie) for business users.
Participate in, and contribute towards daily standup meetings, project planning sessions, and retrospectives.
Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis.


Required

WHAT YOU WILL BRING / QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE


Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work on large data sets, while keeping the big picture in mind.
Strong SQL skills and intermediate Python. An understanding of Spark and distributed compute environments.
Experience and proficiency performing data analysis using Databricks or similar technologies (2+ years).
Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Stats, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent experience.


Nice To Have


Passion & love for music.
Fluency in French


COMPETENCIES


Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
Emotionally intelligent
Commitment to Continuous Learning
Process Oriented

SOCAN is committed to providing an inclusive workplace environment that meets the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities. Title: Data Analyst, Revenue Operations
Description:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

Revenue Operations at FacilityOS owns the data layer behind how we go to market and how we build that that layer out on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, sourced primarily from Salesforce and our GTM stack.

We are hiring a Data Analyst to own the models and reporting that sit on top of it. This is not a dashboard-maintenance role. You will build the semantic models, write the transformation logic, and be the person the GTM leaders and CRO come to when a number doesn't reconcile.

The role suits someone who has spent two to four years doing real analytics work and wants ownership of a data platform rather than a queue of report requests.

What You'll Own


Semantic models and reporting. Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and reports covering pipeline, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion, retention, and customer health. Own the definitions, not just the visuals.
Data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build and maintain pipelines and notebooks bringing Salesforce and GTM system data into the lakehouse. Own transformation logic, refresh schedules, and data quality checks.
Analysis that changes decisions. Quarterly pipeline and coverage analysis, segmentation and territory work, win/loss and cohort analysis, and ad hoc investigation into why a metric moved. Bring a recommendation, not just a chart.
Data integrity across the GTM stack. Reconcile Salesforce against downstream systems, find and fix the breaks, and flag the process problems causing them.
Documentation. Metric definitions, model lineage, and runbooks that let someone else pick up your work.


Required

What we're looking for


2–4 years in an analytics, BI, or data analyst role, ideally supporting a B2B SaaS revenue or GTM function
Strong SQL — joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning
Hands-on Power BI: data modelling, DAX, star schema design, performance optimization
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a cloud platform. Microsoft Fabric is what we run; Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery experience translates
Python for data work — transformation, API pulls, automation
Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (objects, relationships, reporting quirks)
Able to take an ambiguous business question, decide what analysis actually answers it, and present the result to leaders without hand-holding


Nice to have


dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Experience with Gainsight, Gong, SalesLoft, Clay, ZoomInfo, or HubSpot
Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics — ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback
Git and a habit of version-controlling analytical work


How We Work

You will often be the most technical person in most rooms you're in. That means explaining your work clearly, pushing back when a request is the wrong question, and being direct about what the data does and doesn't support.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Compensation Range: CA$85K - CA$95K

Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder relationship skills.

Title: Senior Associate, Data Analyst
Description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,Senior Associate, Data Analyst

About Capital One Canada

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

We’re driven by what’s possible, leveraging the power of data and technology to empower innovative solutions, inspire one another to dream boldly, and take transformative ownership of decisions and outcomes that directly impact millions of Canadians. Every challenge is an opportunity to lead from the front, working together toward a shared vision that extends far beyond banking.

We balance high-performance with investment in your long-term success, ensuring you have the support you need to do your best work. Here, you’ll take full accountability for your path, upskilling through hands-on experience and mentorship, to turn your curiosity into a career built on your own terms.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

About The Team

Data is at the centre of everything we do at Capital One. Your role as a Data Analyst on the team will heavily leverage your deep expertise in SQL. You will be a creative data wrangler, comfortable with extracting, transforming and analyzing large, complex datasets to uncover new narratives. This requires more than just the ability to write complex, performant queries; you must also possess a thorough understanding of database structures, query optimization techniques and best practices for data governance. Ultimately, you will be a proactive collaborator, skilled at articulating complex ideas through data visualization tools like QuickSight, Tableau or Matplotlib and eagerly sharing your knowledge across diverse teams.

About The Role

In this role, you will serve as a vital partner to the business, influencing strategy and execution across key areas like fraud prevention, credit risk or marketing. This role requires a blend of advanced technical analysis skills and strong business acumen to tackle complex challenges and deliver groundbreaking solutions. You will be responsible for translating technical insights into clear, concise and actionable strategic recommendations. Success in this position involves working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to implement strategies and innovative solutions that enhance performance, mitigate risk and drive profitable growth.

Your Responsibilities:


Strategic Stakeholder Partnership & Business Recommendations:


Engage directly with senior stakeholders (e.g., line-of-business leads, product owners, risk management) to deeply understand business goals, challenges and decision needs. Partner with them to prioritize initiatives and refine strategies. Drive business strategy by proactively identifying, quantifying risks and translating complex analysis into compelling, concise recommendations that guide critical roadmap and decision-making processes.


Actionable Insight and Executive Storytelling:


Draw clear business conclusions and present comprehensive insights that explain "what happened," "why it happened," "what it means" and "what we recommend doing next" (including risk mitigation or growth levers). Design and deploy rich data visualizations and craft crisp, executive-ready narratives and dashboards to empower senior leadership to make high-stakes decisions efficiently.


End-to-End Data Analysis and Execution:


Lead the full data analysis lifecycle, translating complex business problems into defined specifications and final implemented solutions.


Data Preparation & Transformation:


Apply expert-level SQL skills to efficiently transform raw data into clean, accessible datasets for yourself and other analysts.


Governance, Reporting and Automation:


Build, automate and maintain critical business reporting and controls for processes and proactively identify and deliver process improvements for efficiency.

Basic Qualifications:


At least 2 years of professional experience with SQL (e.g., Snowflake, MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, etc.).
Proficient in SQL for data extraction, wrangling and advanced analytics including Joins, Window Functions, CTEs, Aggregations and performance trending across large enterprise data environments.


Preferred Qualifications:


Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a quantitative field such as Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
At least 1 year of professional experience using dbt (data build tool) for data transformation, modeling and maintaining a production-ready data warehouse.
At least 1 year of experience applying strong analytical and mathematical skills to solve complex business problems.
Effective stakeholder management experience with strong skills in communication, negotiation, strategic thinking, influence and technical abilities is highly desirable.
Proficient in data analysis within a cloud environment, including experience with open-source programming (e.g., Python), advanced SQL for large datasets (e.g. Snowflake), version control (e.g. Git/GitHub) and cloud services (e.g. AWS).
Experience with Linux or equivalent is preferred.


Working at Capital One.

You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.


Take ownership of your own potential:


Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.


Find your rhythm:


We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.


Benefits built for your life:


We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

The expected annual salary range for this position is $112,240 to $128,100. This role is also eligible to earn performance-based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non-discretionary depending on the plan.

However, no hiring decisions are made using AI as every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers, business interviewers, and recruitment professionals. Our teams are equipped with training that empowers them to use AI responsibly.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at ARCanada@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. Role: Logistics Data Analyst

Reports to: Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics

Status: Full-Time, Regular

Division: Enercare Home and Commercial Services

Location: Markham (Birchmount)

Compensation: $69,136 - $110,618

Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics, the Logistics Data Analyst plays a critical role in transforming warehouse, distribution, inventory, and service parts data into actionable insights that drive measurable operational improvements.

This role supports Enercare's supply chain strategy by developing dashboards, analyzing operational performance, improving inventory accuracy, and enabling data-driven decision-making across logistics, warehousing, and field service operations. The successful candidate brings strong analytical rigor, curiosity for operational processes, and the ability to convert complex datasets into meaningful recommendations that improve service levels, productivity, inventory management, and customer outcomes.

Accountabilities

Performance Management & Reporting


Develop, maintain, and continuously improve operational dashboards and performance reporting related to inventory accuracy, replenishment effectiveness, Parts on Truck (POT%), technician productivity, and other key logistics KPIs.
Transform large and complex datasets into actionable insights and recommendations for operational leaders and stakeholders.


Inventory Accuracy & Control


Redesign and manage ABC, control-group, and random cycle count programs; conduct gap analysis; establish counting frequencies; and recommend SOP improvements to improve inventory accuracy and compliance.
Support root-cause investigations and corrective actions related to inventory variances, stock discrepancies, and transaction integrity.


Warehouse & Distribution Analytics


Analyze warehouse and distribution material flow (receiving → put-away → storage → picking → packing → shipping) to identify bottlenecks, reduce cycle times, and improve operational efficiency.
Monitor inventory movement, aged inventory, and replenishment performance and recommend actions to improve service levels and reduce working capital.


Parts & Field Service Analytics


Conduct truck stock and service parts analytics, including usage modeling, min/max optimization, seasonality reviews, replenishment cadence evaluation, and standard truck stock recommendations aligned to 80/20 principles.
Develop insights and recommendations that improve Parts on Truck (POT%), parts availability, technician productivity, and First-Time-Fix performance.


Continuous Improvement & Automation


Support continuous improvement, Lean, and 5S initiatives by translating KPI trends into practical operational improvements, standard work, and visual management solutions.
Monitor, validate, and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, and automated reports to ensure data integrity and usability.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data quality, and eliminate manual processes.


Ad Hoc Analysis & Business Support


Deliver high-quality, decision-grade analytics to support operations, procurement, supply planning, and cross-functional business initiatives.
Collaborate with operational leaders to identify performance gaps and develop actionable solutions.


Operational Flexibility


This role will evolve with the needs of the business. The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate flexibility and agility by taking on additional duties, special projects, and cross-functional responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives, operational priorities, and continuous improvement initiatives.


KPIs You Will Influence


Inventory Accuracy (%)
Cycle Count Compliance (%)
Variance Closure Time
Parts Replenishment Stability
Min/Max Adherence
Parts on Truck (POT%)
Technician Productivity
Inventory Availability and Fill Rate
Aged Inventory Reduction
Improvements correlated to First-Visit - Rate (FVR) through optimized truck stock and parts availability


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
4-7+ years of experience in warehouse, distribution, inventory, or supply chain analytics with a demonstrated history of improving operational KPIs.
Proficiency with ERP, WMS, and reporting systems; SAP experience is considered a strong asset.
Advanced Excel skills and experience using Power BI for dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience working with SQL, Power Query, or other data analysis and transformation tools is considered an asset.
Experience cleaning, transforming, validating, and analyzing large operational datasets.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to develop structured, pragmatic, and actionable analytical approaches.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of logistics operations, including inventory control, replenishment, receiving, warehousing, picking, shipping, and supplier performance management.
Familiarity with Lean principles, 5S, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Title: Claims Data Analyst
Description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at one of the world’s leading insurance providers? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Claims Fraud Analyst to join the Data, Analytics & Artificial Intelligence team, supporting Claims and Fraud partners.

This role will help strengthen Zurich Canada’s ability to identify potential claims fraud, leakage, unusual patterns, and emerging risk indicators through data, analytics, and business insight.

The successful candidate will work closely with Claims, Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Technology, and analytics teams to review claims data, develop fraud indicators, validate trends, and translate findings into clear recommendations that support better claims outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity to combine claims knowledge, analytical thinking, and investigative curiosity to help protect Zurich, our customers, and the integrity of the claims process. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do


Analyze claims data to identify potential fraud patterns, unusual activity, leakage, overpayments, and other risk indicators.
Partner with Claims and SIU teams to support investigation prioritization, case reviews, and indicator refinement.
Review historical fraud cases and pending claims to identify recurring themes, emerging trends, and opportunities to improve detection.
Develop dashboards, reports, and analysis that help business partners understand fraud trends, payment patterns, vendor activity, and claim behaviours.
